===== [p338-338] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.26.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Overall electrical interface design: (1块) =====
--[p338 [表]]-- Overall electrical interface design:
A number of signals provide for wafer transfer handshaking and data transfer. They connect to the 6DS-SP through opto isolators to a parallel interface board plugged into the 6DS-SP control computer.
The wafer transfer handshake signals are:
6DS-SP Inline | 6DS-SP to Sender
Ready | 6DS-SP to Sender 6DS-SP to Sender (Note: active low)
Alarm
Transfer Request | Sender to 6DS-SP
Wafer Set | Sender to 6DS-SP
Lot End | Sender to 6DS-SP (Note: active low)
The data transfer signals are:
Command and data (10 bits) Sender to 6DS-SP
Strobe | Sender to 6DS-SP
Acknowledge | 6DS-SP to Sender

===== [p233-233] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Detection of Failure to Home: (3块) =====
--[p233]-- Detection of Failure to Home:
Version 4.34 adds a means to detect if a servo controller board (DCX board) fails to home. (Homing is also called referencing.)
During machine startup, homing sequences are downloaded to the DCX boards. These sequences are automatically run on the DCX boards with the 6DS-SP waiting for them to finish.
--[p233]-- If this alarm is seen, a homing macro instruction was probably not successfully downloaded to a DCX board during software startup or a DCX board may be defective.
For technicians: If a homing error occurs, register 125 "DCX Homing ERR" will display the axis number that failed to home. Pressing Alt-R when in the Diagnostic menu will show registers.
--[p233]-- Previously, the "referenced" indication could show on the screen even if the actual homing didn't occur due to absent or corrupt homing sequences on a DCX board or a possibly defective DCX board.
Now, each homing sequence is checked to verify it occurred. If any has a problem, alarm 125 "DCX HOMING MACRO FAILURE (abort clears)" will show.

--[p208]-- The sequence attempts to blow off the carriers as part of the sequence to ensure that don't stick to the spindles when the spindles raise. This sequence was different than blowing off used in the carrier unloading chart and was not as reliable. The sequence now works the same as in the carrier unloading chart and should leave an unlatched carrier on the load station as reliably.

--[p207 [表]]-- All of the many ways a cycle can end will now properly work as shown in the table below:
Type of cycle end Example
Processing ends normallyWith wet idle | Auto cycle ends normally (no more wafers, &quot;finish cycle&quot;selected, etc.)
Processing ends with errorWith wet idle | Unexpected wafer at load station during auto cycle.
Processing ends normallyWithout wet idle | End of a manual auto cycle.
Processing ends with errorWithout wet idle | Many of the start alarms.

This was the original sequence until version 4.33 when an unrelated design change reversed the order. ===== [p271-271] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.31 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Carrier X Theory of Operation: (5块) =====
--[p271]-- Also, regardless of units desired, the wafer area is used for conversions so the wafer diameter must be set in the Machine Parameters menu, page 1.
--[p271]-- Approximately 2 psi extends the piston plate placing it against the membrane for wafer sensing and wafer loading. Vacuum retracts it placing it clear of the membrane for polishing or wafer pickup.
During polishing, the polish recipe's "Polish Force" and "Ring Force" and their ramp times determine how pressures are controlled. "Polish Force" is applied to the wafer. The software adds "Polish Force" and "Ring Force" values and applies the total to the spindle.
--[p271]-- The polish force status display ("Frc") is calculated from the actual pressure behind the membrane. This calculation involves the "membrane value" and "offset" calibration variables. The ring force is the value from subtracting this calculated polish force from total spindle force. The units for both will be psi or lbs depending on the units selected for polish force.
--[p271]-- The actual ring force will indirectly result from the difference between polishing force and total spindle force. Also, the left and right force scaling values in the Machine Parameters menu and various Carrier X calibration variables are used to create the desired polish and ring force. Note: The membrane offset value from calibration variable 108 is not scaled and is subtracted after the scaling factor is used.
--[p271]-- Carrier X Theory of Operation:
Two closed loop pneumatic systems are used for polishing, wafer loading, and wafer unloading. One applies pressure behind the Carrier X membrane. The other applies pressure to the entire spindle assembly. For polishing, the carrier retaining ring contacts the pad and its force will be the difference between the membrane and spindle forces.
Also, a third pneumatic system operates a piston plate within the carrier.

===== [p427-427] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Cycle Start "No Active Receive Cassette" Error Check: (2块) =====
--[p427]-- Cycle Start "No Active Receive Cassette" Error Check:
A new cycle start error check will prevent a cycle start if no receive cassette is active. In the "matched" mode a receive cassette must be active for each spindle used. (This error check is not performed when using a scrubber.)
This error check prevents a situation where the machine could be started with no active receive cassette and one is not installed by the time wafers are polished.
--[p427]-- While another "no active receive cassette" error will show in this situation, a wafer could still dry out on the robot if the operator does not respond.

===== [p394-395] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.20 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Manual Control Menu Zero Spindle Force Handling (for technicians): (5块) =====
--[p395]-- Therefore, a "0" force entry is ignored until the spindles are first lowered and a non-zero force entered. The force algorithm will then be used for the remainder of that Manual Mode session. This ensures that the only effect on the spindle when first lowered will be due to the "move down" force.
--[p394]-- Manual Control Menu Zero Spindle Force Handling (for technicians):
Version 4.20 handles Manual Control menu selected spindle force differently than previous versions.
This is the sequence of events starting at a point when not in the Manual Control mode (status display not showing "Manual Mode", spindle is up, force entry is "0"):
1) Choose "down" for the "Spindle Up/Down" choice.
--[p395]-- This prevents a spindle up/down oscillation that could otherwise occur if the "pressure minimum" calibration value is too low (spindle would lower, force algorithm would start, spindle would raise due to low "pressure minimum", spindle would lower, etc.) The spindle should now reliably lower without chance of oscillation when first requested.
--[p395]-- The spindle will move down using the "move down" calibration value appropriate for the machine configuration and location of the bridge. The closed loop force algorithm will not be used yet.
2) When a non-zero value is entered into the "Spindle Down Force" choice, the force algorithm will then be used.
3) If zero is subsequently entered into the "down force" choice, the force algorithm will continue to be used.
--[p395]-- However, if the "pressure minimum" is too low, an oscillation can still be seen, but it would not occur until after first lowering a spindle and entering some non-zero force.

===== [p438-438] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Loading from a load station: (2块) =====
--[p438]-- Loading from a load station:
1) In the 6DS-SP’s Machine Parameters menu set for “Left Spindle Only”.
2) Place an empty cassette in the 6DS-SP’s send station (so that an automatic cycle can start).
2) Place an empty cassette in the 6DS-SP’s receive station.
3) Place a wafer on the load station for the spindle being used.
4) In the 6DS-SP’s Auto Polish menu select “Start W/Unld”.
5) Start the 6DS-SP when ready.
--[p438]-- 6) At some point after robotic motion is observed, select “Finish Cycle” in the Auto Polish menu so that the 6DS-SP will stop after one wafer.
The wafer will be removed from the load station, placed in the Nova station, “learned”, and then removed from the Nova station and placed in the receive cassette.

===== [p137-137] USER INTERFACE REFERENCE > DIAGNOSTICS MENU: (4块) =====
--[p137]-- DIAGNOSTICS MENU:
This menu permits viewing of all inputs, all outputs, all flags, and many counters.
It also permits changing outputs, flags, and counters. If any choice is made, Stat: will change to Diag Mode. When in Diag Mode, "Freeze Flag" 99 will be turned on. This flag freezes most flowcharts in the FloPro control software. This prevents the control software from competing with the changes you make.
--[p137 [表]]-- Therefore, only qualified personnel should change outputs, flags, or counters.

===== [p204-204] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Choice for No HydroLift Spray During Wafer Unloading: (3块) =====
--[p204]-- Choice for No HydroLift Spray During Wafer Unloading:
Version 4.36 adds a choice to turn off the HydroLift load station's strong lifting spray during wafer unloading. Typically, this spray is used for both wafer loading and wafer rinsing. However, depending on application (such as small light wafers) the spray may lift the wafer back onto the spindle during rinsing. The spray can also float the wafer out of position before the robot can retrieve it.
--[p204]-- Note: If fountain rinsing is enabled in Machine Parameters pages 3, even if the fountain rinse time on page 2 is set to zero, the HydroLift spray will be on during the rinse sequence. This is because outputs 70 and 71 are turned on at the start of the rinse sequence if fountain rinsing is enabled.
--[p204]-- This new choice makes sure that outputs 37 and 38 (carrier pad spray outputs that utilize the HydroLift spray) are off at these times.
Calibration variable 238 "No HydroLift w/unload(0-n,1-y)" sets this choice.
Set to "0" and the HydroLift spray will be on when wafers are unloaded from the spindles and for a short time after the spindles raise.
Set to "1" and the HydroLift spray will be off during wafer unloading from the spindles.

===== [p395-395] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.20 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > DCX Servo Controller Board Error Message (for technicians): (2块) =====
--[p395]-- This message usually means a catastrophic problem has occurred such as a failed board, cut ribbon cable, or software failure on the controller board itself.
--[p395]-- DCX Servo Controller Board Error Message (for technicians):
Version 4.20 adds an emergency warning message that will show if a DCX servo controller board's command buffer does not become clear in a timely manner.
This is not a regular alarm and only shows on the screen. (This is similar to the emergency axis move error messages.)
The message will show which board(s) is at fault.

===== [p392-393] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.20 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Additional Light Tower Configuration: (5块) =====
--[p393]-- Calibration Variable 41, "Lot Integrity (0-dsbl, 1-enbl)", must be set to "1" to cause proper lot end signals to a scrubber and proper lot end events for GEM.
If set to "0", a send cassette will immediately become active (and move into position) even if wafers from the previous lot are still in process. Lot end events can then occur at the wrong time.
--[p393]-- Also, if a scrubber is being used and wafers were placed in a receive cassette due to a scrubber failure, the lot end event will not occur until those wafers are eventually transferred to the scrubber or the receive cassette's arm is raised.
--[p393]-- If set to "1", a lot end event does not occur and a subsequent send cassette is not made active until the last of the previous send cassette's wafers have been polished and delivered to its receive port (cassette or scrubber). At that time, the subsequent send cassette will become active and move into position.
--[p392]-- Yellow | Receive cassette (never) ready to be removed or send
cassette empty and became inactive
Green | Processing (In a cycle) | (never) Idle
Improved "Lot End" Handling for Scrubber and GEM:
Version 4.20 improves the accuracy of lot end event reporting regarding the many possible lot end scenarios. This includes the scenario when a two wafer batch is being polished but each wafer is from a different lot.
--[p392 [表]]-- Additional Light Tower Configuration:

===== [p195-195] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Choice for No HydroLift Spray During Nova Handling: (2块) =====
--[p195]-- Choice for No HydroLift Spray During Nova Handling:
Version 4.37 augments the choice to prevent the HydroLift load station's strong lifting spray being turned on after wafers are unloaded, a choice added in version 4.36.
If using the Nova system, the HydroLift sprays will normally turn on if unloaded wafers on the load stations are waiting for wafers to be handled from the Nova buffer through the Nova station.
Calibration variable 238 "No HydroLift w/unload(0-n,1-y)" sets this choice.
--[p195]-- Set to "0" and the HydroLift spray will be on when wafers are unloaded from the spindles and for a short time after the spindles raise. The spray will also turn on if unloaded wafers are waiting for Nova wafer handling to finish.
Set to "1" and the HydroLift spray will be off during wafer unloading from the spindles. This will also prevent the spray from turning on if wafers are waiting for Nova wafer handling.

===== [p403-405] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.18 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Inline Scrubber Configuration Support: (9块) =====
--[p405]-- The arm length is adjustable to support either diameter to optimize the positioning of the device between the carriers.
Function key choices have been slightly changed from previous versions. The Set Outer and Set Inner choices are now on the "other" function key choice row. The Times=1st and Forces=1st have been replaced with a Colmn=Cursor choice. The Column=Cursor choice causes all twenty values in a column to match wherever the cursor is resting.
--[p405]-- Colmn=Cursor can be used for either times or forces.
Calibration variable 23 "Cond2 present(0-no,1-yes)" must be set to "1" if the optional secondary table conditioner is installed.
The following menus have support for the secondary table conditioner:
Auto Polish Cycle menu:
The Park Arm1&2 choice will cause both arms to park simultaneously.
--[p403]-- Unlike the "L" configuration, the inline configuration uses a vacuum end effector to hold the wafer while transporting it from the 6DS-SP to the scrubber. The end effector also has blowoff that is present any time the vacuum is not.
Calibration variable 140 "Scrubber orientation (0-L, 1-I)" ("L" or "Inline") and Calibration variable 164 "Scrubber present (0-no, 1-yes) are both set to "1" for the inline configuration.
--[p403]-- Inline Scrubber Configuration Support:
Version 4.18 adds support for an inline configuration scrubber. "Inline" refers to how the scrubber is positioned relative to the machine (not how the wafer actually moves). Note the following drawings that contrast the inline configuration with the "L" configuration:
With the inline configuration, the wafer exits the machine at the left receive position and makes a 90 degree turn into the scrubber.
--[p403]-- The scrubber station will appear in the Homing and Manual Control menus where the left receive station would otherwise show. The Manual Control menu page will also show the scrubber effector vacuum as an on/off choice.
The blowoff rate and the vacuum switch set point are both adjustable.
The blowoff rate is adjusted with a flow control mounted on the end effector vacuum valve in the water valve panel area. Adjust the rate to gently blow off a wafer.

--[p404]-- The vacuum switch is mounted on a bracket with the end effector vacuum valve. The software monitors this switch to determine if a wafer is securely held. A suggested setpoint is 5 psi. If the wafer is not securely held at this setpoint, then use a higher value as needed.

===== [p366-368] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.23.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Expose Table 2 Feature: (4块) =====
--[p368]-- The pusher will start retracting and also, after a small delay, the arms open. At this time, the "wafer set" signal is sent to the scrubber. When the scrubber acknowledges it has received the wafer, the arms close.
--[p367]-- After the wafer is pushed out of the 6DS-SP, these arms open to release the wafer onto the scrubber's handling system.
Calibration variables that define the wafer handling configuration must be set as follows:
The wafer release arms are controlled by output 115 "Scrub arms open". The arm positions are monitored by input 73 "Scrub arms open" and input 74 "Scrub arms clsd".
During operation, the wafer is pushed into the arms.
--[p367]-- Version 4.23 adds support for a "U" scrubber with Nova configuration for a two table machine as shown below. The "U" relates to the arrangement of the 6DS-SP and scrubber.
This configuration has the scrubber station in the "left receive" location just like an "I" scrubber. However, the "U" scrubber does not have an end effector. Also, the "U" scrubber has a pair of wafer release arms at the end of the wafer pushing mechanism.
--[p366]-- Expose Table 2 Feature:
Version 4.23 adds an Expose Table 2 function key choice to the Auto Polish menu for machine equipped with the secondary polishing table. This choice can be used to expose the secondary table surface for pad changing.
When the Expose TBL2 function key choice is selected, the robot, shuttle, and bridge will move as necessary to expose the table surface. The polish door must be closed or the choice will be ignored.

===== [p195-195] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Added Changes to Use Slurry Systems 1 and 2 "Alarm #2" Inputs More Fully: (3块) =====
--[p195]-- Added Changes to Use Slurry Systems 1 and 2 "Alarm #2" Inputs More Fully:
Version 4.37 adds changes and corrects to the handling of slurry system 1 and 2 "Alarm #2" inputs. These are inputs 47 and 48. They have always been used if the "dual slurry source" feature is installed. However, the "alarm action" feature added in version 4.29 removed all other testing of these inputs when the "bulk slurry halt" feature was removed at that time.
--[p195]-- You can now use normally open inputs 47 "Slry 1 alarm #2 and 48 "Slry 2 alarm #2" for configurations without dual slurry source. You can link any resulting alarms to any of the alarm actions.
Calibration variable 250 "Use input 47/48 alrms(0-n,1-y)" enables/disables monitoring of slurry alarm inputs 47 and 48 for machines without the dual slurry source option.
--[p195]-- Machines not using these inputs may not have the corresponding input module installed which will show as "alarm on" if variable 250 enabled.
NOTE: This variable has no effect if using the dual slurry source option.
REMINDER: To inhibit a cycle start due to a slurry alarm, you must set calibration variable 59 "Slry alrm cycl inhibit:0-n, 1-y" to "1".

===== [p77-77] USER INTERFACE REFERENCE > Entering numbers: (2块) =====
--[p77]-- When the first number entry key is pressed, the field color will change to red which means the value is in the process of being input by the user but is not yet confirmed by pressing the Enter key. An unconfirmed value can still be edited. When the Enter key is pressed, the value showing is confirmed and the cursor color changes back to yellow.
Escaping can be done by either using the Escape key, moving the cursor off of the item, or selecting a menu.
(The same rules apply for entering letters when creating a recipe name.)
--[p77]-- Entering numbers:
Numbers are conventionally entered using numerals, the decimal, the hyphen, and the Enter key. The Backspace and Escape keys can also be used.
Sometimes numbers are entered into "fields" in the menu area and sometimes they are entered at the end of the prompt line.
Number entry areas will first be yellow.

===== [p430-434] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Hardware: (4块) =====
--[p434]-- Hardware:
The Nova system consists of a “front end” computer, a “back end” computer, a measurement unit, wafer handling components, and a buffer cassette.
The Nova “front end” computer provides the Nova operator interface and is located outside of the 6DS-SP.
The Nova “back end” computer provides control of the Nova measurement device and is located in the 6DS-SP cabinet above the elevator section.
--[p430]-- Hardware:
The 6DS-SP computer’s parallel port is used for the data transfer. Parallel data and handshake lines are connected through opto-isolators to a connector to the scrubber.
--[p434]-- The Nova measurement unit is mounted in the “right receive” location of the 6DS-SP and is controlled by the back end computer.
The Nova wafer handling components are mounted immediately above the measurement unit and are controlled by the 6DS-SP. The major wafer handling components in the Nova system are the “wafer support arms” and a “wafer chuck”. The wafer chuck is at the end of a shaft which can move vertically and has top, bottom, and middle positions.
--[p434]-- When lowering, the shaft will lower to the bottom position if the wafer support arms are open but will lower only to the middle position if the arms are closed due to a mechanical stop. Also, the wafer chuck has blowoff, vacuum, and a vacuum switch. Finally, a wafer sensor detects when a wafer is present in the Nova system.
The “right send” position is used as a buffer cassette and is controlled by the 6DS-SP.
Therefore, there is only one send cassette location (left send) and only one receive cassette position (left receive).

===== [p249-249] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.33 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > To use this feature: (5块) =====
--[p249]-- For subsequent lots during the same automatic cycle, if a recipe is not received for a new lot the machine will go idle at the end of the previous lot with no alarm.
--[p249]-- For subsequent lots, once the last wafers of the previous lot are unloaded from the carriers AND the first wafers of the next lot are loaded onto the carriers AND any exsitu conditioning from the previous lot is complete, the queued recipe associated with the next lot is loaded and the cycle continues.
Note: Remember that ex-situ conditioning is part of the recipe and therefore is part of the processing time for a lot and its associated recipe.
--[p249]-- \- Another lot can be placed in the machine while the previous lot is processing.
\- The Host then queues a recipe name for that next lot.
\- That first lot finishes processing and can be removed.
\- New lots with new Host queued recipes can be put in the machine indefinitely.
--[p249]-- The machine will not process a lot if it has not received a recipe name from the Host for that lot (even if recipe will be the same as the previous lot). When starting the machine to process the first lot, if a corresponding recipe has not been received from the Host, the alarm 82 "PP SELECTION NOT QUEUED" will show, the cycle will not start, and the machine will go to idle.
--[p249]-- To use this feature:
Calibration variable 41 "Lot integrity (0-disbl, 1-enbl)" must be set to "1".
Machine Setup menu "Wafer Source/Recipe Source" must be set to "Cass/GEM queue"
General sequence of events:
\- Place lot (cassette) in machine.
\- Host queues a recipe name to be used for that lot.
At the start of the auto cycle, the queued recipe is loaded to ensure that any possible pre polish recipe related actions occur.
\- The first lot starts processing.

===== [p215-215] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Support for Independent Control of Four Passage Rotary Unions: (3块) =====
--[p215]-- Support for Independent Control of Four Passage Rotary Unions:
Version 4.35 adds support for independent control for each passage of four passage rotary unions.
Note: The following Viprr configurations have existed:
Two passage control of a two passage union. This will still be supported.
Three passage control of a four passage union with passages three and four "tee-d" together. This configuration will not be further supported and is obsolete starting with this software version.
--[p215]-- Calibration variable 237, "4 passages controlled(0-n,1-y)" sets the configuration:
Set to "0" for machines with two passage rotary unions (standard carriers or two passage control of Viprr carriers).
Set to "1" for machines with four passage rotary unions (Viprr using four passages or Carrier X.)
--[p215]-- To use this software version, machines using four passages must be plumbed, or re-plumbed, for independent control to all four passages.
For four passage Viprr or Carrier X operation, solenoid valves are dedicated for chucking vacuum to the fourth passage. This is a steady vacuum to hold the carriers to the chucks in the same way standard carriers are held in a two passage system. Carrier latches are not required but can still be used for carrier drop protection.

===== [p429-429] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Time Delay Increased for "Wafer not found on robot" Alarm: (1块) =====
--[p429]-- Time Delay Increased for "Wafer not found on robot" Alarm:
The time delay before the "wafer not found on robot" alarm shows has been increased from 10 to 15 seconds. This is intended to prevent nuisance errors due to the occasionally longer time required for the vacuum chuck to extract water from the surface of a hydrophilic wafer.

===== [p364-364] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.23.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > ViPRR Operation In Maintenance Menus: (2块) =====
--[p364]-- ViPRR Operation In Maintenance Menus:
In the Manual Control menu, ring force for a spindle is forced to zero when the spindle is first lowered. This is to make sure that total spindle force equals polish force during calibration. However, once the spindle is lowered, the ring force counters (59 and 60) can be changed in the Diagnostics menu and they will not be further changed by the manual control menu so long as an abort does not occur.
--[p364]-- In the Diagnostics and Calibration menus, the status area Frc values represents wafer polishing force (total spindle force with ring force subtracted) just like during actual polishing. Therefore, be sure to calibrate spindle force only when the ring force is zero (counters 59 and 60 must be zero).

===== [p318-318] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.28 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Backpressure Process Alarms: (2块) =====
--[p318]-- Backpressure Process Alarms:
Version 4.28 adds backpressure process alarms.
The backpressure alarm limits are set in the Alarm Parameters menu. A "zero" entry will disable alarm testing for that entry. The alarm limit entry units are "delta psi". Therefore, the alarm limit is set to a fixed difference from whatever is desired in the polish recipe regardless of units used (psia or psig).
--[p318]-- Backpressure alarms are monitored along with the other polish alarms along after a 15 second delay after each polish step start. The 15 second delay will also restart if a parameter is changed in the Polish Parameters menu during polishing.

===== [p254-255] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.33 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Procedure: (4块) =====
--[p255]-- 13) If the MACHPC was used to transfer the software to the GEM PC, disconnect the interface cable from the GEM PC's COM1 and reconnect it to the GEM PC's COM4.
--[p254]-- Procedure:
All keyboard entries and screen displays will occur at the BOOTPC.
1) Power up BOOTPC and GEMPC.
2) Allow DOS to boot on the BOOTPC.
NOTE: Do Not Use a DOS Window to execute the following steps. If the BOOTPC is running Windows it must be restarted in MS-DOS mode.
3) Insert the GEM INIT/UPGRADE disk into the floppy drive A: of the BOOTPC.
4) Type "A:<Enter>".
If using COM1 of the BOOTPC type "VSC <Enter>". If using COM2 of the BOOTPC type "VSC /2 <Enter>".
--[p255]-- 6) Wait for the program to load from the floppy disk. A message should appear at the top right corner of the screen that indicates the program is active.
7) Press the <Alt> and <Space Bar> keys simultaneously. A new DOS shell should appear on the screen. If no information appears on this screen after pressing the Alt-SpaceBar key combination, cycle the power on the GEM PC. Once the GEM PC reboots press the Ctrl-Break key combination to exit any executing program.
8) Press <Enter>.
--[p255]-- A DOS prompt originating from the GEMPC should appear on the screen.
9) Type "S:\UPGRADE<Enter>". The screen should indicate that the self-extracting archive file GEM350.EXE is being copied. The file copy will take about 3 minutes. After the file has been copied it will be unzipped.
10) Wait for copying and unzipping to end.
11) Type <Alt> and <Space> simultaneously. The previous DOS shell should appear.
12) Power down both Systems. Upgrade is complete.

===== [p370-371] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.23.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Automatic Set To Operator Password Level: (2块) =====
--[p371]-- As soon as a non-zero value is entered into this variable, the timing will start. After that, each time a key is pressed, the timing is restarted.
"0" disables the feature and any password level will remain indefinitely until changed or the machine is turned off.
--[p370]-- Automatic Set To Operator Password Level:

Calibration Variable 97 "Default to 'Oper' (min, 0-dsbl)" Sets the number of minutes until the password level will automatically change to "Oper" if left in the "Engr", "Maint", or "Supvr" level for specified time without hitting a key. The range for that time is 1 to 99999999 minutes.

===== [p375-378] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.22 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Summary of Software Release Changes: (14块) =====
--[p375]-- If you have any version other than 4.21 installed, you are not up to date on features and possible settings required by any version(s) that was never installed. Refer to documentation for all skipped versions to familiarize yourself with their new features and to perform any special setup required by those versions.
ALSO, if your machine's version is 4.10 through 4.17, you MUST first install 4.18. If your machine's version is prior to 4.10 you MUST first install BOTH 4.10 and 4.18.
--[p378]-- If wafers are not found on the load station, the cycle will not start and the alarm "WAFER NOT SEATING AT LEFT LOAD" or "WAFER NOT SEATING AT RIGHT LOAD" will show. If wafers are not found on the unload station, the cycle not start and the alarm "WFR ABSENT ON THRUPUT UNLD, abort clears" will show.
If a cycle is aborted before wafers are on the load stations, wafers can be manually placed in the load station to use the feature.
However, manually placing wafers on these stations may result in improper "lot end" reporting.
--[p377]-- The maximum resulting force will be the spindle lowering force plus the weight of the carrier until the spindles raise. This would nominally be 10 lbs of lowering force plus approximately 25 lbs for the carrier or 35 lbs total.
Carrier unloading will use calibration variable 49 "Spindles down thruput value". This is the same force used to lower a carrier onto the throughput station during an auto cycle. The force can be typically 10 lbs when the spindle first lowers.
--[p375]-- Summary of Software Release Changes:
Software version 4.22 (March 13, 1997) adds the following features:
\- Support for F-B throughput with four elevators
\- Changed carrier load/unload down forces for F-B throughput
\- Various F-B throughput improvements
\- Second table edge rinsing
\- "Cleaning disabled" notation for certain machine configurations
\- Increased scrubber wafer set error time
\- Improved "No. of Wafers" handling
\- Wafer lift off vacuum alarm
--[p376]-- Version 4.22 adds support for a machine configuration with the "front to back" throughput feature and four elevators.
The following machine configuration calibration variables must be set as follows for "front to back" throughput with four elevators:
Variable 136 "F/B HTP present (0-no, 1-yes)" Set to "1"
Variable 140 "Scrubber orientation (0=L, 1=I)" Set to "0"
Variable 163 "S/S HTP present (0-no, 1-yes)" Set to "0"
Variable 164 "Scrubber present (0-no, 1-yes)" Set to "0"
--[p378]-- The bridge will remain over the polishing table until the wafer loading is complete. Then the bridge will move to the load station (or first to the curtain rinse if using that option) and unloading will commence.
Improved handling of the "start with load" feature if throughput enabled:
To use this feature, wafers (or one wafer if using a single spindle) must be on the load station but not on the unload station.
--[p376]-- However, if the throughput feature is used (by electing "enable" in the Setup menu) the cleaning sprays are blocked by the next wafers to be polished. At these times, cleaning is disabled even if cleaning choices are selected in the Cleaning/Conditioning Parameters menu. As a reminder, the notation "Cleaning disabled when thruput enabled" will show below these choices.
Changed Carrier Load/Unload Downforce for F-B Throughput:
--[p375]-- NOTE: New calibration variables were added in Ver 4.12 that should be set before operating the machine to prevent possible damage to the bridge. Refer to the Version 4.12 software release document.
Also, new calibration variables 176 and 177 were added in Ver 4.14 that must be set so that automatic cycle spindle flushing will operate correctly.
A detailed description of software installation is on the last two pages.
--[p376]-- Variable 181 "Nova present (0-no, 1-yes)" Set to "0"
As in the "side to side" high throughput configuration, the "front to back" configuration has a Machine Setup menu choice to enable or disable using the throughput feature. If disabled, the throughput mechanism will remain out of the way in its front position (nearest the operator door) and will not be used during auto cycling. However, the mechanism will be used for loading and unloading carriers.
--[p377]-- In machines with the "front to back" throughput option, carrier load/unload down forces have been changed to apply lower forces to the throughput shuttle station.
Carrier loading will use calibration variable 48 "Spindles down extra soft value". It can be set for the lowest reliable loading force. (This variable is not used elsewhere in this configuration.) The force must be sufficient to lower a spindle without the weight of a carrier.
--[p376]-- Also, the "front to back" configuration does not have the cleaning stations used with other single table configurations. Instead, the load stations are used as cleaning stations with Cleaning/Conditioning Parameter menu choices for post polish wafer and carrier cleaning. (These are the same cleaning choices that are available for two table machines.)
--[p377]-- After the carrier is unloaded and the spindle raises, the full carrier weight, approximately 25 lbs, will be applied as it rests on the throughput station.
Various F-B Throughput Improvements:
Improved handling at end of polish if next wafers still being loaded:
If wafer loading is still occurring when the polishing cycle ends, the spindles will now raise from the table and rotations will stop. If in-situ conditioning was used, it will end and the arm will move to the outer position.
--[p378]-- If a wafer is found on an unload station, the cycle will not start and the alarm "WFR FOUND ON THRUPUT UNLD, abort clears" will show.
Improved handling of the "start with unload" feature if throughput enabled:
To use this feature, wafers must be on both the load and unload stations (or one wafer on each station if a using single spindle).
--[p375]-- \- Transfer cycle disable of "All Wafers" and "No. of Wafers" choices
\- Support for slurry flow sensing option
\- Assorted GEM changes
Version 4.22 also has partial development for a "U" scrubber configuration but does not support that configuration.

===== [p247-247] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.33 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > STRASBAUGH, INC. (3块) =====
--[p247]-- The status display will show actual forces including the effect of odd polish force adjustments. For polish force and ring force, the status display will now also show the effect of the left and right force scaling recipe values. (Previously, while scaling affected actual force, this did not show in the displayed force). Note that both scaling and odd polish force affect polish and ring forces as follows: Force = Desired recipe force \* Scaling \* Odd polish force adjustment.
--[p247]-- Use the status display to confirm scaling and odd polish adjustments are performing properly.
Also, force alarm handling will include all scaling and odd polish force adjustments. Alarm limits will be calculated for whatever force is currently being attempted.
Finally, if "0%" is entered (or exists from a previous recipe), the default 100% will be used.   
100% (0r 0%) are values that will cause no odd polish adjustment.
--[p247]-- STRASBAUGH, INC.
During odd polish, actual forces will be the original recipe force values multiplied by the "force adjust" percentages. However, the Auto Polish and Sweep Parameter menus will continue to display the original recipe force values during the odd polish cycle. This is different than "Odd Wafer Time Adjust" which modifies not only actual process times but also causes the Auto Polish menu to display the adjusted step times during the odd polish.

===== [p379-379] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.22 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Improved "No. of Wafers" Handling: (1块) =====
--[p379]-- Improved "No. of Wafers" Handling:
Version 4.22 has an improvement to wafer handling when polishing with both spindles but the "No. of Wafers" choice is set to an odd number. (Previously, only even numbers were supported.)
For an odd number of wafers, when the last wafer is loaded no more cassette slots will be searched. The last wafer will be polished as an "odd wafer" on the left spindle. The "Odd Wafer Time Correct" value will be used and a "finish cycle" will occur.

===== [p435-436] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Operation if not using Nova: (4块) =====
--[p436]-- All wafers will be polished and then measured or not measured by the Nova system dependent on communication between the 6DS-SP and the Nova system.
6) When all wafers have been polished and placed in the 6DS-SP receive cassette, the 6DS-SP will return to “idle. The operator removes cassettes from the 6DS-SP.
--[p436]-- The following are the general steps to operate both the Nova system and the 6DS-SP:
1) At the Nova system, the operator logs in and selects “measurement”. Wafer slots can be designated as to whether the wafer should be measured, not measured, or the slot is empty. Also, measuring recipes can be assigned to wafer slots.
2) At the Nova system, “load” is selected. When the “run” choice is enabled, “run” is selected.
--[p436]-- “Wait” will show indicating the Nova system is waiting for a transfer request from the 6DS-SP.
3) At the 6DS-SP, the operator places a cassette of wafers in the send station, an empty cassette in receive station, and an empty cassette in the buffer station.
4) At the 6DS-SP, the operator selects a polishing recipe.
5) At the 6DS-SP, the operator presses the “start” button to start the 6DS-SP automatic cycle.
--[p435]-- Operation if not using Nova:
If the Machine Setup menu Use Nova choice is set to disable wafers will be loaded from the left send cassette, polished, and placed in the left receive cassette. The Nova system will be entirely bypassed and ignored.
Operation if using Nova:
If the Machine Setup menu Use Nova choice is set to enable a polished wafer will be routed through the Nova system if the Nova recipe specifies that wafer should be measured.

===== [p282-282] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.31 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Long Second Table Only Slurry Prestart Choice: (2块) =====
--[p282]-- If variable 213 set to "1", a long slurry prestart will begin when wafer loading from cassettes to load stations begins.

If variable 213 is set to "0", a short slurry prestart will begin when the shuttle moves just prior to polishing.

===== [p332-333] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.27 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > ViPRR Default Pressure Change: (2块) =====
--[p332]-- ViPRR Default Pressure Change:
Version 4.27 changes the retaining ring default pressure after polishing. After polishing, ViPRR pressure is now set to zero instead of a nominal 2 psi. This helps insure that the wafer is not pushed off the carrier. However, retaining ring pressure is set to 2 psi after wafer unloading to extend the ring for proper loading of the next wafers.
Version 4.27 provides support for optional spindle lifting air cylinders.
--[p333]-- These cylinders help make sure the spindles fully raise.
A spindle lifting air cylinder is turned on any time the software attempts to raise it's spindle.   
Left lift cylinder output 112 is turned on whenever left pressure control counter 12 is zero.   
Right lift cylinder output 113 is turned on whenever right pressure control counter 13 is zero.
NOTE TO TECHNICIANS: These lift cylinder outputs are controlled at all times including while in the Diagnostic Mode.

===== [p319-319] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.28 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Backpressure Scaling Entry Limits: (1块) =====
--[p319]-- Backpressure Scaling Entry Limits:
Version 4.28 adds entry limits to calibration variables 67 and 69 which are the left and right backpressure scaling. The limits are 0.5 to 1.5. This especially prevents entry of an unrealistically small number which could cause a mathematical calculation overflow error.

===== [p277-277] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.31 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Carrier X Wafer Loading: (2块) =====
--[p277]-- Carrier X Wafer Loading:
1) Extend piston plate (to push membrane slightly beyond retaining ring). Turn on wafer sensing (will be used later). Turn on load rinse (to wet wafer).
2) Wait 1 second.
3) Turn off load rinse.
4) Move spindle down and wait for it to be detected down.
5) Wait 1 second (to ensure complete carrier seating in load station).
6) Turn on HydroLift lift spray (to raise wafer onto carrier).
7) Wait 2 seconds (to let HydroLift spray seat wafer against carrier membrane).
--[p277]-- 8) Set membrane pressure to full vacuum (to grab wafer).
9) Wait 2 seconds (for vacuum to build and membrane to grab wafer).
10) Retract piston plate (to pull wafer into retaining ring pocket).
11) Raise spindle (Wafer presence will be checked later).

===== [p245-245] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.33 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Further Throughput Improvement with Short Polish Time for F-B Configuration: (1块) =====
--[p245]-- Further Throughput Improvement with Short Polish Time for F-B Configuration:
Version 4.33 starts robot movement to get the next wafers to be polished even earlier than the version 4.32 improvement. This allows a further approximate 15 second reduction for the shortest possible polish time before throughput is affected.

===== [p248-248] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.33 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Independent Left and Right Spindle "Loop Gain" Variables: (5块) =====
--[p248]-- This ensures the machine will behave exactly as it did before upgrading software.
SPECIAL NOTE: If you upgrade from a previous version, the older "loop gain" variables 50 and 57 are no longer used. However, they will still remain in the Calibration/Configuration disk file CALVARS.DAT. If you load a version older than 4.33, that older version will use the older variables and not the new ones.
--[p248 [表]]-- Previously, the same value applied to both spindles and there was no way to adjust for pneumatic or mechanical differences in the left and right spindles. It is now possible to make individual adjustments to the behavior when pressures build.
The following table shows the previous two "loop gain" calibration variables and the four new variables that replace them.
Previous variable (obsolete) | New left spindle variable | New right spindle variable
--[p248]-- This can change the behavior of the machine because each older variable is used for two spindles and the values won't reflect any subsequent calibration changes in the new variables.
--[p248]-- Independent Left and Right Spindle "Loop Gain" Variables:
Version 4.33 has changes to provide independent left and right "loop gain" variables for each spindle. These variables determine the behavior of the spindle downforce and the backpressure (or membrane pressure if using Carrier X). These changes obsolete variables 50 and 57 that had applied to both spindles.
--[p248]-- 50 &quot;Pressure control loop gain&quot; | 229 &quot;L press control loop gain&quot; | 230 &quot;R press control loop gain &quot;
57 &quot;Back/membrane press cntrl gain&quot; | 231 &quot;L back/membrane pres cntl gain&quot; | 232 &quot;R back/membrane pres cntl gain &quot;
NOTE: When first installing this or any later software version, if all of the new variables are found to be zero, the software will automatically load them from the old variables and a red screen will notify.

===== [p287-288] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.31 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Procedure: (4块) =====
--[p287]-- Procedure:
All keyboard entries and screen displays will occur at the BOOTPC.
1) Power up BOOTPC and GEMPC.
2) Allow DOS to boot on the BOOTPC.
NOTE: Do Not Use a DOS Window to execute the following steps. If the BOOTPC is running Windows it must be restarted in MS-DOS mode.
3) Insert the GEM INIT/UPGRADE disk into the floppy drive A: of the BOOTPC.
4) Type "A:<Enter>".
If using COM1 of the BOOTPC type "VSC <Enter>". If using COM2 of the BOOTPC type "VSC /2 <Enter>".
--[p288]-- A DOS prompt originating from the GEMPC should appear on the screen.
9) Type "S:\UPGRADE<Enter>". The screen should indicate that the self-extracting archive file GEM350.EXE is being copied. The file copy will take about 3 minutes. After the file has been copied it will be unzipped.
10) Wait for copying and unzipping to end.
11) Type <Alt> and <Space> simultaneously. The previous DOS shell should appear.
12) Power down both Systems. Upgrade is complete.
--[p288]-- 13) If the MACHPC was used to transfer the software to the GEM PC, disconnect the interface cable from the GEM PC's COM1 and reconnect it to the GEM PC's COM4.
--[p288]-- 6) Wait for the program to load from the floppy disk. A message should appear at the top right corner of the screen that indicates the program is active.
7) Press the <Alt> and <Space Bar> keys simultaneously. A new DOS shell should appear on the screen. If no information appears on this screen after pressing the Alt-SpaceBar key combination, cycle the power on the GEM PC. Once the GEM PC reboots press the Ctrl-Break key combination to exit any executing program.
8) Press <Enter>.

===== [p345-345] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.26.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Known AGV related issues with Version 4.26.1: (3块) =====
--[p345]-- The 6DS-SP will not support an automatic start based on AGV transfer protocol. It must be started normally. (This is another new request that needs more specification.)
--[p345]-- However, if polishing with two spindles, if the wafer is the second of a pair, wafer data integrity will be lost unless a single spindle "start with load" cycle is used to clear the first wafer from the machine. (This may be the only practical solution.)
The 6DS-SP may not properly handle an odd wafer scenario if using AGV.
The 6DS-SP will not display AGV data on its screen (another new request that is not yet specified).
--[p345]-- Known AGV related issues with Version 4.26.1:
If the AGV > Scrubber transfer cycle is used and the scrubber fails, wafers will not be placed in a receive cassette. The cycle will stall.
If the AGV sender takes a wafer back from the AGV station, there should be no problem of polishing with only one spindle.

===== [p438-441] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Direct cassette to Nova transfer: (7块) =====
--[p441]-- Nova Done/Skip: Nova to 6DS-SP. Indicates wafer has been measured and can be removed by the 6DS-SP if Nova-Online/Ack is on. Indicates wafer is to be skipped if the Nova-Online/Ack is off.
Nova-Online/Ack: Nova to 6DS-SP. Indicates the Nova system is on and present. At other times the line is used as an acknowledge.
--[p438]-- Direct cassette to Nova transfer:
This feature permits direct transfer of wafers from the send cassette to the Nova stations.   
This permits wafer measurement without a polishing sequence.
If the Nova option is installed (calibration/configuration variable 181) The Machine Parameters Menu, page 1, will permit the added choice NovaXfer for Auto Cycle Operation in addition to Auto, Manual, and Condition.
--[p439]-- If the NovaXfer choice is made, the machine will attempt to transfer wafers from the send cassette to the Nova station when the "start" button is pressed. (All other recipe menu choices are ignored.) If the wafer is not to be measured, it will bypass the Nova system and be placed in the receive cassette.
Suggestion for setup and operation:
1) Create a recipe named "NOVAXFER" that has Auto Cycle Operation set to NovaXfer in page 1 of the Machine Parameters menu.
--[p439]-- In addition to making sure wafers are clear of the usual places (spindles, tables, etc.) wafers must also be clear of the Nova measurement system and the buffer cassette.
Clearing a wafer from the Nova measurement system:
At the Nova front end computer, pause the measurement and then choose to abort when given the choice to abort or continue.
Open the elevator access door.
--[p440]-- Open the elevator access door and remove the wafer.
Lower the cassette arm to prepare the buffer cassette for the next cycle.
6DS-SP/Nova communication handshake signals (for technicians):
6DS Request/Set: 6DS-SP to Nova. 6DS-SP requests permission to transfer a wafer to the Nova system. At other times the line is used to inform Nova that a wafer has been set in place.
6DS-Online/Ack: 6DS-SP to Nova. Indicates the 6DS-SP system is on and present. At other times, used as an acknowledge.
--[p439]-- 2) Set other recipe elements in the recipe menus to default values such as "0" for polish steps, "disable" for enable/disable choices, etc.
3) Simply select "NOVAXFER" from the Recipe Management menu whenever the function is needed.
The descriptive name and the absence of recipe settings should make it obvious that it is not a polishing recipe.
6DS-SP Wafer Clearing after an ABORT:
An abort can result in stranded wafers anywhere in the 6DS-SP.
--[p440]-- Using the Nova choices in the 6DS-SP’s Manual Control screen, manipulate the Nova wafer handling components to place the wafer on the wafer support arms.
Manually remove the wafer from the Nova wafer support arms.
Clearing a wafer from the buffer cassette:
Open the elevator access door and raise the buffer cassette arm. (This will tell the 6DS-SP that you plan to remove the wafer and the 6DS-SP will assume that you did.)
Close the elevator access door and let the elevator rise to the top.

===== [p186-186] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Primary Conditioner Cleaning Feature: (4块) =====
--[p186]-- For example, if calibration variable 210, "Don't park after batch:0-n,1-y " is enabled, or if ex-situ conditioning is about to occur after in-situ conditioning, the arm will not move to the park position and cleaning will not occur.
--[p186]-- Primary Conditioner Cleaning Feature:
Version 4.37 adds a feature to clean the primary conditioner at its rinse tank after automatic cycle ex-situ conditioning, in-situ conditioning, or demand conditioning. ===== [p206-206] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Choice to Inhibit Life Counting if Using Low or Zero Polish Times: (3块) =====
--[p206]-- Choice to Inhibit Life Counting if Using Low or Zero Polish Times:
Version 4.36 adds a choice to inhibit pad, carrier, and primary conditioner life counting and timing for low or zero polish times. This permits wafer handling testing without advancing life counters or timers. Such testing uses no polishing or only "touch down" polishing. This feature expects "touch down" polishing to one second or less.
--[p206]-- In a production environment, this choice can prevent needlessly advancing life counts during testing which can lead to early pad replacements, etc. However, if desired, life counting can still be permitted if the number of test cycles must be recorded regardless of polish time values.
Calibration variable 240 "No life count if <5sec(0-n,1-y)" sets the choice.
If set to "0", all life counting and timing occurs regardless of polish times. (This was the behavior before this choice was added.)
--[p206]-- If set to "1", pad, carrier, and primary conditioner life counting and timing are inhibited for any cycle where the total of all left and right polish step times (steps 1-10 for single table machines and steps 1-20 for two table machines) is less than five seconds. For example, if a two table machine has step 1 left and right times at one second and step 11 left and right times at one second and all other steps zero, the total is four seconds.
Even though "touch down" polishing occurs, life counting/timing would not occur.

===== [p157-157] USER INTERFACE REFERENCE > FileVars (Make ASCII File of Variables) Utility Program: (1块) =====

You are prompted for a file name up to eight characters. Do not enter an extension. The extension "TXT" will be automatically added.
The resulting file will have your filename as the first record followed by the 256 calibration variable names and numbers.

--[p368]-- Also, along with the alarm the controller, if so configured, can set a "finish cycle" state in the 6DS-SP. When set to "finish cycle", the 6DS-SP will finish the currently processing wafers but not start any new ones.

The controller sends a message of one of four possible alarm conditions and the 6DS-SP will display the alarm in the alarm area. The four alarms are:

The alarm means a control correction is indicated that is outside of predetermined limits.

===== [p309-309] IMPORTANT ! > Show Last Alarm Text Feature: (2块) =====
--[p309]-- Show Last Alarm Text Feature:
Version 4.29.1 has an optional feature to show the last alarm text in the alarm area after all alarms are cleared. This feature is selected with calibration variable 202 “Show last alarm text (0-n,1-y)”. This makes it possible to determine the last alarm when there is no access to a keyboard to select the Alarm Log menu.

===== [p221-221] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Right Backpressure Disabled During Odd Polish: (2块) =====
--[p221]-- However, if the recipe has backpressure set to a vacuum, the open right carrier holes could cause a degradation of overall vacuum in the machine and reduce the vacuum available to the left carrier. This change prevents either pressure or vacuum from being applied to the right carrier backpressure during an odd polish cycle.
--[p221]-- Right Backpressure Disabled During Odd Polish:
Version 4.35 makes a change to ensure that the right spindle back pressure is not used during odd polishing when the right spindle has no wafer.
Previously, a positive backpressure would blow air out of wafer mounting plate holes on the empty right carrier. This is apparently harmless.

===== [p245-247] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.33 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Note to technicians: (3块) =====
--[p247]-- Note to technicians:
For Viprr and Carrier X equipped machines, when in the manual or diagnostic modes, the ring force will not be involved in spindle force calculation. This ensures that that the displayed force corresponds to the force requested in the Manual Control menu. For Viprr, once in the manual mode, the Viprr ring counters 59 and 60 can be set to any value.
--[p247]-- As before, it is important that left and right force scaling in the Machine Parameters menu, page 1, be set to 100% while calibrating down force. But if they are not, their effect will now show in the status display and therefore be more obvious.
--[p245]-- Note to technicians:
The scaling factor affects the requested ring force. For example, a ring force recipe value of 2.0 psi with 102% scaling will cause 2.04 psi to be the requested ring force. The change in counts seen in counters 59 and 60 due to 102% versus 100% may be a different ratio because the calculation uses calibration variable 198 "Viprr ring offset (lbs)" as an offset. And that offset is not scaled.

===== [p426-426] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Polish Halt upon High Table 1 Temperature: (2块) =====
--[p426]-- A polish halt will occur if the primary table temperature exceeds the high table temperature polish alarm value in the Alarm Parameters menu. (Note that this value is always entered in degrees C.)
To disable the feature enter "0" into the calibration variable.
--[p426]-- Polish Halt upon High Table 1 Temperature:
This feature can be used to cause a halt during primary table polishing if the table temperature exceeds a preset value. Excessive temperature can be caused by excessive friction if some failure (or mistake) prevents slurry from reaching the table.
To enable this feature enter "1" into Cal Variable 17 "TBL1 Hi temp halt (0-no, 1-yes)".

===== [p344-344] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.26.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Odd Wafer Handling if using AGV: (1块) =====
--[p344]-- Odd Wafer Handling if using AGV:
If the "Odd Polish" choice is disabled, the 6DS-SP will always expect two wafers for each polish cycle. (The two wafers can be of different lots).
If the "Odd Polish" choice is enabled, the 6DS-SP will polish the last wafer of an odd numbered lot if a "lot end" transaction happens before or almost immediately after the 6DS-SP picks up the wafer from the AGV load station.
If the lot end signal comes much later it will be too late because the automatic cycle will already be expecting a second wafer.

===== [p284-284] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.31 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Serial Port Error Handler Removed: (2块) =====
--[p284]-- Serial Port Error Handler Removed:
Version 4.31 removes an software error handler related to the GEM implementation. (This error handler actually "trapped" any low level bios errors.) This error handler permitted software to continue running even though the main computer's serial port had an error. This was originally needed for the previous "SECS only" implementation where the main computer's serial port was a user connection and even a wrong baud rate would cause a serial port error.
--[p284]-- With the GEM implementation, the main computer's serial ports are connected to another computer internal to the machine so there is no longer exposure to user connection port problems. However, if the 6DS-SP GEM computer has a problem, or if there is problem with the automatic download of new GEM software with a software upgrade, the software will now stop with the error message "Device I/O error in module SPMACHPC at ####:####.
To help avoid such errors, be sure to install software only by means of the complete installation procedure with actual installation disks.

===== [p405-406] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.18 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Operation: (2块) =====
--[p405]-- Operation:
The secondary table in-situ conditioning is set similar to the primary table conditioner:
For continuous conditioning, set the duty cycle to 100%.
For duty cycle conditioning, set the duty cycle to the percentage of time conditioning should occur. For example, if conditioning is desired 25% of the time, set the duty cycle to 25%.
--[p406]-- After the two way conditioning sweep, the arm will raise and pause before the next sweep an amount of time such that the time on the table is about 25% of total time.
If the duty cycle is set to 0%, a single two way sweep will occur.
When homing "All" axes, the secondary conditioning arm will be homed first. If homing only the bridge or robot, the secondary conditioner armed will be automatically homed and parked first if not already homed and parked.

===== [p220-220] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Restored Original "Expose Table 2" Action: (1块) =====
--[p220]-- Restored Original "Expose Table 2" Action:
Version 4.35 restores the Auto Polish menu "Expose Table 2" action to always move the shuttle to the rear regardless of the type of load station used. In Version 4.25, November 21, 1997, the feature was changed to move the shuttle to the front if using HydroLift load stations. This change has been removed.

===== [p352-352] NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Slurry Priming Feature: (3块) =====
--[p352]-- Finally, if the machine has the slurry diverter option, both diverter valves for the selected slurry system(s) will be opened and both lines will be primed.
--[p352]-- Slurry Priming Feature:
Version 4.24 adds a slurry priming feature to the Slurry Flush menu. This permits the operator to reliably prime the slurry lines with slurry. This is especially useful after slurry flushing if the lines are long. This feature can be used to make sure all water is purged and no polishing occurs with residual water. (Note: For some applications the "long" or "long/short" slurry prestart choices may be sufficient to make sure all water is purged.)
--[p352]-- The new recipe element Prime Time sets the slurry priming period.   
The slurries that will be primed and the flowrate will be whichever are selected for flushing.
A new function key choice Slurry Prime starts the priming sequence.
When chosen, the status line will show "Slurry Sys Prime".
The Slurry Prime choice can only be used if the machine is not in an auto cycle or otherwise busy in a way that would conflict with priming.

===== [p325-325] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.28 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Miscellaneous Improvements: (3块) =====
--[p325]-- Previously, the enable valves had been observed cycling on and off during the priming cycle.
The wafer vacuum error will now show if using the "slide and lift" feature (selected by calibration variable 141). Previously, the cycle correctly stalled with insufficient vacuum, but did not show the error.
All conditioning choices can now be changed either by an engineer, by GEM recipe selection, or by AGV recipe selection even while in an Auto Cycle.
--[p325]-- Miscellaneous Improvements:
Version 4.28 has the following miscellaneous improvements:
Math overflow errors are no longer possible when entering an unrealistic in-situ conditioning duty cycle value versus total in-situ conditioning sweep time.
Recipe "Store" and "Delete" keys will now be properly dimmed in an auto cycle when in the supervisor or factory test maintenance password levels.
Slurry priming (the F5 choice on the Slurry Flush menu) should now work correctly.
--[p325]-- However, anytime primary in-situ conditioning is selected during an auto cycle and either the inner or outer position is set to zero, the in-situ conditioning will not be enabled and the alarm "COND1 IN-SITU IN OR OUT POSITION IS ZERO" will show. This prevents the arm from moving to a zero "outer" position that is actually at the table center.

===== [p79-79] USER INTERFACE REFERENCE > MENU GROUPING AND RECIPE DEFINITION: (4块) =====
--[p79]-- (Machine settings which are seldom or never changed reside in the Calibration/Configuration menu.)
The maintenance menus work together as a group. If any change is made in the Manual Control Menu the status line will show Manual Mode. If any change is made in the Diagnostic Menu the status line will show Diag Mode. As long as menu selection involves only the maintenance menus, the changes will remain.
--[p79]-- However, if a door is opened in the manual mode, choices in the section protected by the door's interlock will be cancelled. Finally, if a non-maintenance menu is selected, an automatic abort/reset will occur to clear the changes and reset the machine back to normal.
--[p79]-- MENU GROUPING AND RECIPE DEFINITION:
The menus are divided into five groups:
Operation
Process Setup (recipe)
Machine Setup (Routinely changed machine setups that are not process related)
Maintenance
Miscellaneous
The Slurry Flush Menu and Recipe Management Menu apply to both operation and recipe setup.
Menu select function key label rows are organized as shown below. One group at a time will show.
--[p79]-- The recipe is defined as everything seen in the Slurry Flush Menu and everything in the "parameter" menus. (NOTE: With previous software, only polish parameter values were saved as the recipe.) Since everything in these menus can affect processing in some way, they are included in the recipe.
The Machine Setup menu contains machine setups that are commonly changed as part of machine operation but are not process related.

===== [p262-262] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.32 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Queue GEM Remote Start Command when in Wet Idle Spindle Flush: (1块) =====
--[p262]-- Queue GEM Remote Start Command when in Wet Idle Spindle Flush:
Version 4.32 permits sending a GEM remote start command to the 6DS-SP during wet idle spindle flush.
Previously, the 6DS-SP would respond with "Cannot perform now" (HCACK = 2) and ignore the command.
Now the 6DS-SP will queue the start command and respond with "Acknowledge, command will be performed with completion signaled later by an event" (HCACK = 4). At the end of the spindle flush, the 6DS-SP will leave wet idle and start.

===== [p442-442] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Operation if not using the throughput option: (1块) =====
--[p442]-- Operation if not using the throughput option:
If the Machine Setup menu Use Throughput choice is set to disable, wafers will be loaded from the send cassette to the load stations, polished, unloaded to the load stations, and placed in the receive cassette. The throughput mechanism and the throughput unload station will not be used.

===== [p364-365] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.23.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Support for Latched Carriers: (3块) =====
--[p364]-- Support for Latched Carriers:
Version 4.23 adds support for carriers with optional mechanical latches. All ViPRR carriers for the 6DS-SP must have these latches because vacuum is not available to hold the carriers to the spindles. Non-ViPRR carriers, which use vacuum to hold the carriers, may optionally have these latches to prevent carrier dropping if vacuum is lost.
Calibration variable 200 "Carrier latches (0-no,1-yes)" must be set to "1" for latched carriers.
--[p365]-- NOTE: Some carriers may have spring loaded latches with parts that protrude higher than the carrier top surface. These parts can mechanically interfere with the spindle quill ball in some machine configurations during bridge and shuttle moves while the carriers are resting on the load stations. If your carrier/machine combination has this possible interference, orient the scribed line on the carriers as shown before loading or unloading carriers.
--[p365]-- Latched carrier loading or unloading is a three step procedure because the operator must latch or unlatch the carriers midway through the sequence. The following are the procedures:

===== [p349-350] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.26.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Installing new software from floppy disks to the machine: (4块) =====
--[p349]-- Installing new software from floppy disks to the machine:
NOTE: Two diskettes are used to install the software.
1) If the "DOS" prompt "C:\QB45>" is not already showing on the screen, do the following: In the main menu, type ALT+Q (press the ALT and Q keys together). This should cause the DOS prompt "C:\QB45>" to show.
2) Insert the "INSTALL DISK #1" into the machine's disk drive.
3) Type: ”A:INSTALL 4261” and press ENTER Files will automatically be copied from the disk to the machine.
--[p349]-- Remove the diskette when done.
4) Insert the "INSTALL DISK #2" into the machine's disk drive.
5) Type: ”A:INSTALL 4261” and press ENTER Files will automatically be copied from the disk to the machine. Remove the diskette when done.
6) Remove any floppy disk in the machine and turn the machine off and back on to start the new software.
7) Set the following calibration variables.
--[p350]-- IMPORTANT: Be sure to check variable 100 which will may already contain some value (because it was previously used in older software versions).
Variable 100, "AGV present (0-no, 1-yes)"
Set to "0" if the AGV feature is installed.
Set to "1" if the AGV feature is not installed.
Variable 186, "Scrb data xfr(0-dsbl, 1, or 2)"
Set to "0" if not using scrubber data transfer (no scrubber or Ontrak scrubber.
Set to "1" if using a 3 byte data transfer (DNS scrubber or a Yuasa scrubber used without AGV).
--[p350]-- Set to "2" if using a 4 byte data transfer (Yuasa scrubber with AGV).
Variable 88 "Thruput unload/AGV up/dn top" Variable 89 "Thruput unload/AGV up/dn bot"
These are robot up/down variables for the AGV station. They only need to be changed if an AGV station has been installed and these variables were never calibrated.
NOTE: When done saving or installing software, remove the floppy disk from the computer disk drive. Always keep floppy disks in a cool dry place.

===== [p319-319] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.28 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Curtain Rinse Spindle Speed Choices: (1块) =====
--[p319 [表]]-- Curtain Rinse Spindle Speed Choices:
Version 4.28 permits five spindle speed choices during curtain rinse instead of the original fixed 10 rpm. This change permits a faster full revolution which can be used to decrease throughput time.
The Machine Parameters Menu, page 3, curtain rinsing choices are now:
Curtain Rinsing | Disable
Enbl 10rpm
Enbl 20rpm
Enbl 30rpm
Enbl 40rpm
Enbl 50rpm
The "Enbl 10rpm" choice means the same as the original " Enable" choice.
Therefore, existing recipes will not be effected and will still be enabled at 10 rpm or disabled.

===== [p345-345] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.26.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Problem Handling: (3块) =====
--[p345]-- The wafer's Cassette ID, slot ID, and scrubber recipe ID will be remembered so long as the receive cassette is not removed from the 6DS-SP.
If a halt occurs, the 6DS-SP will halt normally and also halt any wafer handling transaction with the AGV. If the auto cycle is resumed (by pressing the "start" push button), the wafer handling transaction will resume.
If severe problems occur, the operator will probably have to manually remove wafers from the 6DS-SP.
--[p345]-- When this is done, wafer slot integrity will be lost.
Finally, the operator should not start the 6DS-SP with a wafer on the AGV station. (The 6DS-SP cannot physically detect the wafer's presence.)
--[p345]-- Problem Handling:
If a 6DS-SP "NO AGV TRANSFER REQUEST" alarm occurs, the 6DS-SP will wait indefinitely for a wafer. If the transfer request occurs, the alarm will automatically clear and the transfer cycle will continue.
If the scrubber fails, wafers will be routed to the receive cassette (if it is installed). Wafers can be subsequently transferred to the scrubber.

===== [p283-283] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.31 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Forced Curtain Rinse with Front-to-Back High Throughput: (3块) =====
--[p283]-- Forced Curtain Rinse with Front-to-Back High Throughput:
Version 4.31 adds a feature to force curtain rinsing to protect wafers from drying. This can be used if, after polishing, wafers must wait awhile to be unloaded if the previous and next wafers are still being handled.
Previously, this protective curtain rinsing occurred automatically but only if curtain rinse was enabled in the recipe. After 15 seconds of waiting, curtain rinsing is started.
--[p283]-- Any non-zero value (0-250 rpm) enables the feature and sets the forced curtain rinse spindle speed. Variable 212 contains the time (0- 300 seconds) for rinsing each spindle.
NOTE: If both the recipe curtain rinsing and forced curtain rinsing are enable, the recipe curtain rinsing values are used and the forced curtain rinsing values are ignored.
--[p283]-- Every 15 seconds there is an attempt to start curtain rinsing if not already rinsing.
This feature permits the same protection even if curtain rinsing is disabled in the recipe. Two calibration variables enable the feature, set the spindle speed, and set the curtain rinse times. They are:
Calibration Variable 211 "Force F-B curtain (rpm,0-dsbl)"
Calibration Variable 212 "Force F-B curtain time (secs)"
Entering "0" into variable 211 disables the feature.

===== [p282-282] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.31 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Throughput Improvement, Conditioning Starts when Current Rinse Ends: (2块) =====
--[p282]-- Throughput Improvement, Conditioning Starts when Current Rinse Ends:
Version 4.31 adds a throughput improvement when current rinsing and ex-situ conditioning are both used. This change permits conditioning to start without waiting for the bridge move to the load station after curtain rinsing ends.
Now, if curtain rinsing involves the right spindle (using both spindles or right spindle only), ex-situ conditioning will start immediately when curtain rinsing ends.
--[p282]-- This is safe because the bridge is clear of the conditioning arm when at the right curtain position. If using only the left spindle, the bridge will not be clear of the arm after curtain rinsing and conditioning will then start until after the bridge moves to the load station.
Also, an additional check to ensure wafers are on the spindles has been added before starting curtain rinsing to prevent starting conditioning if wafers were left on the table.

===== [p409-409] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.18 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Endpoint Pressure Control Disable:Endpt Pol Step (3块) =====
--[p409]-- Endpoint Pressure Control Disable:Endpt Pol Step
Version 4.18 adds the ability to disable the reduction of polish force to minimum and setting<sup>Timed</sup><sub>steps</sub> <sup>Aborting</sup><sub>during</sub> of backpressure vacuum during endpoint events. This is useful when both spindles arestep 3 always being endpointed together and the desire is to merely advance to the next step.
New calibration variable 31"Endpt (0-drop pres,1-keep pres)" permits the choice.
--[p409]-- If variable 31 is set to "1", Polish force and backpressure will be left alone ("kept") when an endpoint event occurs just as if the "Next Step" choice had been made on the Auto Polish menu.
--[p409]-- If variable 31 is set to "0", polish force will be set to minimum ("dropped") and backpressure to full vacuum (if backpressure is enabled for the table) for each endpoint event for each spindle. This will occur even if both spindles are endpointed simultaneously. Polish force or backpressure in a subsequent step will again build as they do when they are in the first step.

===== [p391-391] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.20 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Auto Cycle Action if Leak Feature: (2块) =====
--[p391]-- If set to "0", the Auto Cycle will continue and attempt to polish subsequent wafers.
If set to "1", any leak will both cause an alarm and automatically set the "finish cycle" mode to finish all wafers in process but not start any new ones from the send cassettes.
--[p391]-- Auto Cycle Action if Leak Feature:
Version 4.20 adds a feature that will cause a "finish cycle" if any of three possible fluid leak sources are detected. The finish cycle lets the current wafers finish processing but will not start any new wafers. The leak sources are the primary table drain pan overflow, the drip pans at the bottom of the machine, and the optional external leak detector input.
Calibration Variable 53 "Action if leak (0-no,1-finish)" enables the feature.

===== [p309-309] IMPORTANT ! > External Alarm Support: (3块) =====
--[p309]-- External Alarm Support:
Version 4.29.1 adds support for a general purpose external alarm. Any external system or sensor can use this alarm to show an alarm condition on the 6DS-SP. The alarm can also take advantage of the 6DS-SP alarm action feature.
This alarm is digital input 71 “External alarm”. If this alarm is asserted, the alarm message “EXTERNAL ALARM” will show. The alarm will continue to show until cleared. This is alarm #231.
--[p309]-- The alarm will be logged and the alarm action feature can be used. (As with other alarms, a higher priority alarm may prevent this alarm from showing, but any configured alarm action will still occur.)
Calibration variable 203 "External alarm (0-no, 1-yes)" enables or disables the monitoring of this input. This variable should be set to 0 if the alarm is not used or if mounting rack 6MR is not installed. If the mounting rack is absent, the input will be read as "on".
--[p309]-- Note: 6DS-SP inputs are turned “on” by pulling them to the 6DS-SP’s 24 VDC ground. This should be done with either relay contacts or the output of an opto-isolated circuit. Such isolation helps prevent electrical problems that can occur when different systems are directly connected together.

===== [p291-291] IMPORTANT ! > Partial Finish Cycle for HTP Configurations: (3块) =====
--[p291]-- (This has been the normal finish cycle until this release.) For example, in an HTP machine with HTP enabled, this could include wafers currently polishing and also wafers on the load stations waiting to be polished. For dual spindle polishing, this will usually be four wafers.
If set to "1", only one set of wafers is cleared and wafers on the load stations waiting to be polished are not polished. The "Start with Load" feature can then be used to start the next cycle.
--[p291]-- For dual spindle polishing, this will usually be two wafers.
Note: The complete HTP loading cycle will occur regardless of when the finish cycle starts. Only after wafers are unloaded from the spindles is a test made to determine whether or not the remainder of the cycle will fully clear the machine, or be a "partial clear".
--[p291]-- Partial Finish Cycle for HTP Configurations:
Version 4.30 adds a partial finish cycle feature for HTP equipped machines. This feature is applicable when the Use Thruput (in auto cycle) choice on the Setup menu is enabled.
Calibration variable 204 "HTP fin cycle (0-all, 1-partial) enables or disables this feature.
If set to "0", a finish cycle that completely clears the machine occurs.

===== [p391-392] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.20 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Externally Detected Leak Input: (3块) =====
--[p391]-- If set to "1", the external leak detect input will be monitored for the purposes of an alarm showing "EXTERNAL LEAK DETECT". Also, it may be used along with other leak detection features depending on the settings of variable 53 "Action if leak (0-no,1- finish)", variable 54 "Slry/DI off w/leak(0-no,1-yes)", and variable 191 "Abort idle if leak(0-no,1-yes)".
Version 4.20 adds support for an internal leak detect output (Output 120 "Int leak detect").
--[p391]-- Externally Detected Leak Input:
Version 4.20 adds support for an externally detected leak input (Input 69 "Ext leak detect"). This input can be controlled by an external system which is monitoring its own leak sensors located in or around the 6DS-SP.
Calibration Variable 190 "Ext. leak detect (0-no, 1-yes)" enables the feature.
If set to "0", the external leak detect input will be ignored. Also, if digital mounting rack "6MR" is not installed, this variable must be set to "0".
--[p392]-- This output will turn on whenever the internal drip pan leak input is on. An external monitoring system can use this output to detect a 6DS-SP drip pan leak.
