===== [p185-185] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Feature to End Primary Table In-Situ Conditioning after a Selected Step: (2块) =====
--[p185]-- Setting "0" (the default and the value in existing recipes before this change) will cause in-situ conditioning for all steps.
For example, assume a five step recipe where you want steps 1 through 4 to have in-situ conditioning but not for step 5. You enter "4". At the end of the fourth step, in-situ conditioning will end.
--[p185]-- Feature to End Primary Table In-Situ Conditioning after a Selected Step:
Version 4.37 adds a recipe parameter that specifies the last primary polish step that will have in-situ conditioning. The last step can be any value from 1 through 10. When that step finishes, the conditioning arm will move to the "in-situ outer" position and the arm will raise for the duration of the polish cycle.

===== [p448-449] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.15 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Example: (6块) =====

For conditioning, slurry will be routed to table 1.

If Slurry 1 Source is set to Tank the valve that routes slurry from the 6DS-SP slurry tank to Slurry 1 will turn on. The valve that routes bulk slurry to Slurry 1 will turn off.

===== [p347-347] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.26.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Nuisance Force Alarm Improvement: (2块) =====
--[p347]-- Nuisance Force Alarm Improvement:
Version 4.26 changes the calculation for the polish alarms for force. The calculation now uses a different error band during ramping.
Previously the error band was the percent of the desired instantaneous force value. During ramping, this instantaneous value linearly increases from zero to the recipe step value. Therefore, the error band gradually increased from zero to some maximum value.
--[p347]-- For a long ramping time, the error band could still be quite small after the 15 second alarm holdoff period.
Now the error band is the percent of the recipe step value at all times. This provides a larger constant and larger error band during ramping. The error band is the same once the desired force reaches the final value.
The figure below graphically shows the previous and new error bands.

===== [p162-162] USER INTERFACE REFERENCE > DcxCntrl (DCX Control) Utility Program: (4块) =====
--[p162]-- DcxCntrl (DCX Control) Utility Program:
DcxCntrl is a utility program originally supplied by Precision Micro Control, Inc., the manufacturer of the DCX servo control boards used in the 6DS-SP.
This program provides a direct PC to DCX interface. This program will send any characters typed at the keyboard to the addressed DCX board, and display any characters received from the board.
This program also can be used to download a file of commands to the DCX board.
--[p162]-- (The original program would not pause to permit viewing such errors.)
NOTE: For DcxCntrl, board selection numbering starts at "0". (This is the same as the settings on board programming switches.) Therefore, the two boards are "0" and "1" for this program.
You can start the program by typing DCXCNTRL /B0 (for board 0) or DCXCNTRL /B1 (for board 1). If you type only DCXCNTRL, it will assume board 0.
You can stop the program with Cntrl-C.
Refer to the Precision Micro Control, Inc.
--[p162]-- However, this is not recommended user operation because repeated downloading, even of the same information, can cause the DCX board's memory to be exceeded. It is best to let the 6DS-SP's Autoexec.bat file automatically download initialization files by performing a machine power off/on.
Strasbaugh, (with permission from Precision Micro Control, Inc.) has modified the original program to prompt the operator if the DCX board detects an error when downloading file commands.
--[p162]-- manual for further information on this DCX product.
CAUTION: Only experienced technicians should use this utility program because it allows sending unrestricted commands to servo systems.

===== [p427-427] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Additional Wafer Handling Tests: (2块) =====
--[p427]-- A check is made to make sure the wafer deposited on the load chuck by the robot is still present after the robot arm returns to the zero position. If the wafer is not detected the cycle will not continue. After a brief delay the error message "Wafer not found at left load" or "Wafer not found at right load" will show because the chuck vacuum will be on without a wafer present.
--[p427]-- Additional Wafer Handling Tests:
Two tests during the Auto cycle have been added to improve wafer handling reliability.
The load chucks are now raised during the wafer presence testing that occurs during cycle start testing before every loading cycle. This helps ensure that a wafer accidentally left in the load chucks will be detected even if it is not fully seated.

===== [p449-450] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.15 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Direct Cassette to Scrubber Transfer (for scrubber equipped machines): (4块) =====
--[p449]-- Direct Cassette to Scrubber Transfer (for scrubber equipped machines):
August 11, 1995
This feature permits direct transfer of wafers from the receive cassette to the scrubber.
If the scrubber option is installed (calibration/configuration variable 164) The Machine Parameters Menu, page 1, will permit the added choice of ScrubXfer for auto cycle operation in addition to Auto, Manual, and Condition.
--[p450]-- If the ScrubXfer choice is made, the machine will attempt to transfer wafers from the "unload" cassette (normally named the "receive" cassette in other auto cycle sequences) to the scrubber when the "start" button is pressed. All other menu choices are ignored.
The 6DS-SP will send a "lot end" signal to the scrubber when:
a wafer previously found in the last slot of the cassette is delivered to the scrubber.
\- the last cassette slot is searched and found to be empty.
--[p450]-- the cassette arm has been raised and the last wafer handled has been delivered to the scrubber.
\- operation was aborted and the send cassette arm is raised.
\- searching for wafers in a cassette and the cassette arm is raised.
If scrubber trouble develops during operation and there is a wafer on the robot, the wafer will be returned to the "unload" cassette, the cycle will end, and the machine status will return to "idle". There will be no "lot end" signal.
--[p450]-- The wafer is therefore protected and the transfer cycle can be continued by pressing the "start" button.
Suggestion for setup and operation:
1) Create a recipe named "SCRUBXFR" that has Auto Cycle Operation set to ScrubXfr in page 1 of the Machine Parameters menu.
2) Set other recipe elements in the recipe menus to default values such as "0" for polish steps, "disable" for enable/disable choices, etc.
3) Simply select "SCRUBXFR" from the Recipe Management menu whenever the function is needed.
The descriptive name and the absence of recipe settings should make it obvious that it is not a polishing recipe.

===== [p191-191] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Alarm if Cassette Arm Lifted During Wafer Fetch: (3块) =====
--[p191]-- This alarm is latched and requires and abort to clear it.
NOTE: There is one arm lift scenario where a different alarm condition will show. If the arm is lifted which searching for the first slot, the special warning "OUT OF LIMIT ELEVATOR MOVE!" may show. This is a special alarm that is not logged. The automatic cycle will be stalled requiring an abort. One of the regular alarms such as "LEFT REAR ELEV NOT ARRIVING AT SLOT" will probably also show.
--[p191]-- Alarm if Cassette Arm Lifted During Wafer Fetch:
Version 4.37 adds an alarm if a send cassette's arm is lifted during a wafer fetch from the cassette. An intermittent arm switch will also look like the arm is being lifted. This alarm helps identify such a problem.
If the software detects the arm switch turned off (arm lifted or otherwise), the automatic cycle will quit back to idle as it did before, but now the following alarm will show:
Alarm 222 "CASS ARM UP DURING WFR FETCH(abort clrs)"
--[p191]-- This situation occurs because an attempt is made to raise the cassette to a point higher than its highest safe position. The first alarm indicates the software is refusing the move because it can cause damage. The second alarm occurs because the elevator has been prevented from moving. This alarm can be corrected only by directly entering a permissable slot number into the relevant elevator axis slot command counter (counters 30-33) or powering the machine off and back on.

===== [p344-344] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.26.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Description of AGV> Scrubber Mode: (2块) =====
--[p344]-- Wafer handling is similar to the AGV > Polish > Scrubber mode. However, the 6DS-SP will not accept the next wafer until the previous wafer is sent to the scrubber.
Cassette ID, Slot ID, and Scrubber recipe ID are sent to the scrubber.
--[p344]-- Description of AGV> Scrubber Mode:
The 6DS-SP, scrubber, and AGV must all be turned on. The 6DS-SP can be idle, in screen idle, in wet idle, or in an automatic cycle already (started with the remote "6DS-SP start" button, the 6DS-SP's own "start" button or GEM). The "Auto Cycle Operation" should be set for scrubber transfer. The 6DS-SP and scrubber must both be "inline" and not having an alarm.
The cycle is started (if not already started) when the first transfer request is received.

===== [p291-291] IMPORTANT ! > "Endpoint Spindles Used" Signal Added: (1块) =====
--[p291]-- "Endpoint Spindles Used" Signal Added:
Version 4.30 adds a new interface signal from the 6DS-SP to the endpoint system to indicate which spindles are being used during polishing. An endpoint system can use this signal to ensure an unused spindle is not monitored.
The new signal is output 104 "Endpoint Spindles Used" with the following meanings:
This signal will reliably indicate the spindles that will be used for polishing many seconds before polishing actually starts.

===== [p371-371] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.23.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > F-B Throughput Post Polish Curtain Rinse Wetting: (3块) =====
--[p371]-- Once the robot is no longer busy, the wafers will be unloaded after the current curtain rinse cycle is finished or immediately if within the 15 second delay period and at least one curtain rinse cycle occurred.
--[p371]-- During such times, the curtain rinse will keep the wafers on the spindles wet. Curtain rinsing must be enabled in the Machine Parameters menu to use this feature.
If the robot is busy, fifteen seconds after polishing ends a curtain rinse cycle will begin to make sure the wafers stay wet. If the robot remains busy, another curtain rinse cycle will begin again after another 15 second delay and so forth.
--[p371]-- F-B Throughput Post Polish Curtain Rinse Wetting:
Version 4.23 adds a change regarding how curtain rinsing is used in a front-to-back throughput configuration. Sometimes polished wafers have to wait on the spindles while the robot and shuttle are busy handling the next wafers to be polished or searching an empty send cassette. Sometimes this wait time can be long if the robot is busy searching many empty send cassette slots.

===== [p190-190] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Alarm and Cycle Start Inhibit if Center Protection Enabled and Conditioning Sweep Hazard Exists or Conditioning Device Diameter Set to "0": (5块) =====
--[p190]-- Calibration Variable 236, previously labeled "TBL1 stroke limit(0:6in,1:1in)", is now labeled "TBL1 center protection:0-n,1-y". This variable now enables both this conditioning hazard protection and also the previous oscillation sweep limit of a 1" stroke instead of a 6" stroke.
On the Conditioning/Cleaning Parameters menu, "Cond#1 Device Dia. (if using psi)" will now show as "Cond#1 Device Diameter". The next line will show one of the following:
--[p190]-- Alarm and Cycle Start Inhibit if Center Protection Enabled and Conditioning Sweep Hazard Exists or Conditioning Device Diameter Set to "0":
Version 4.37 adds further protection for the center of the primary table if there is some need keep it clear. This ensures the primary conditioner can't sweep enough during automatic cycles to interfere with the center area of the primary table. That area is a circle with a nominal 1.625" radius.
--[p190]-- If center protection disabled: "(Diameter required only if using psi)" If center protection enabled: "(Diameter required-TBL1 center protection enabled)"
There are two new alarms (each has the same text):
Miscellaneous alarm #223 "CENTER PROTECTION HAZARD OR DEVICE DIA.=0" Cycle Start alarm #70 "CENTER PROTECTION HAZARD OR DEVICE DIA.=0"
The alarm condition will exist for any of the following conditions if Calibration Variable 236 is enabled:
--[p190]-- If set to zero, a known unrealistic value, the software assumes it can't calculate a possible mechanical interference.
(Conditioning/Cleaning Parameters menu page 1.)
Alarm #223 will show continuously (unless a higher priority alarm is showing) until the error condition is corrected.
Alarm #70 will never show on the screen or be logged in the alarm log because the higher priority alarm #223 supercedes it.
However, if an attempt is made to start a cycle, the cycle start will be inhibited and this alarm will be reported to a GEM host.
--[p190]-- Ex-situ conditioning inner position is too small and either ex-situ conditioning is enabled by "COND#1 Ex-situ Interval" being set to a non-zero value or the "Cond#1 Ex-Situ Pre/Post/Once" is set to "Once Only". (Conditioning/Cleaning Parameters menu page 1.)
In-situ conditioning inner position is too small and in-situ conditioning "Cond#1 In-situ Conditioning" is enabled. (Conditioning/Cleaning Parameters menu page 2.)
"Conditioning Device Diameter" is set to zero.

===== [p230-230] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > "Use Partial Send Cassette" Feature: (4块) =====
--[p230]-- "Use Partial Send Cassette" Feature:
Version 4.34 adds a "Use Partial Send Cassette" feature. This feature applies only to machines with two send cassettes. (This is independent from the "No of Wafers" choice on the Auto Polish Cycle and Auto Polish Parameters menus which sets a number of wafers to polish regardless of wafer source.)
Calibration variable 233 "Use partial send cass(0-n,1-y)" disables/enables the feature.
--[p230]-- The allowable range is 1 to the maximum number of slots. The 6DS-SP will then search for wafers starting at slot 1 up to the slot number entered. When that slot is reached, the cassette will be made "inactive" and the automatic cycle will start using the other cassette or, if it is inactive, end the cycle.
This feature permits you to use the "all" slots choice from calibration 40 "Send slots:0-any,1- all,2-first" if all slots starting at slot 1 have wafers up to the desired last slot.
--[p230]-- Remaining slots are ignored and can be empty.
Note: The values entered will remain and will be used for every cycle unless changed by either the operator or by GEM. Also, entering the maximum number of slots will simply cause all slots to be searched as if the feature were not enabled.
--[p230]-- If set to "0", all slots of a send cassette will be searched which is the standard action.
If set to "1", the choices "Left Send No. of Slots Used" and "Right Send No. of Slots Used" will show on the Machine Setup menu as shown. (Note: You may have additional Machine Setup menu items show depending on your machine configuration.)
Enter the number of slots to search for each cassette. The machine will then search only that number of slots. Searching always starts at the top slot in the cassette.

===== [p279-279] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.31 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Carrier X General Information for Technicians: (6块) =====
--[p279]-- Therefore, you can briefly apply vacuum and release it to make sure the membrane is not extended.
Cuation: If you enable membrane pressure with outputs 8 and 10 in the Diagnostics menu, pressure or vacuum will be applied by whatever values are currently in counters 55 and 56. If they are a value that will cause pressure (which is very likely) the membranes will bulge out.
--[p279]-- A hidden item can be made to show by temporarily setting Calibration Variable 205 to "0", making the correction, and then setting 205 back to "1" and then re-saving the recipe.
--[p279]-- Carrier X General Information for Technicians:
Counters 59 and 60 control analog outputs to produce pressure for piston plate extension. These counters are held to "410" which is a nominal 2 psi unless in the diagnostics mode. In the diagnostic mode, the counters can be changed for testing and calibrating. When leaving the diagnostics mode, they will automatically again be held at the value "410".
--[p279]-- For wafer blowoff, the cycle will first put 500 counts into the membrane pressure control counters 55 and 56 (left and right as required) for one second. This causes pressure to quickly build from vacuum to a value that is still below atmosphere but close to it. Then the pressure is increased under closed loop control for the time and pressure entered in calibration variables 169 and 170.
--[p279]-- If water flush valves are present (used with backpressure for other carrier designs), it is best to disconnect them and change the plumbing so there is no chance that water can be injected into membrane pressure system.
Caution: Changing membrane pressure from a positive value to atmosphere may leave the membrane somewhat extended for a period and can interfere with the robot end effector. Changing from membrane vacuum to atmosphere should not leave the membrane extended.
--[p279]-- Many places in the software set these counters to the default value of 819 counts which is close to atmosphere, but usually positive. Therefore, set counters 55 and 56 first. Always be aware of the membrane pressure.
NOTE: A recipe (especially a previously existing recipe) can have a hidden setting, such as spindle flushing, that is inappropriate for Carrier X. The software has been designed to ignore these inappropriate choices. Still, it is a good idea to properly set all choices.

===== [p319-321] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.28 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Bridge Move before F-B Rinse: (5块) =====
--[p321]-- Previously, the bridge and shuttle moved simultaneously with the shuttle arriving first.
This change helps prevent damage if carriers with latches are improperly oriented or if gimbaled carriers are tilted too much.
With this change, if a spindle quill interferes with any part of a carrier, the force will be only that of the shuttle air cylinder instead of the much more powerful bridge movement.
--[p320]-- For the AGV option, the cassette number will be whatever was transferred from the AGV sender ("1" through "4"). If the 6DS-SP's own send cassette was used, the cassette number will be "1".
Version 4.28 changes carrier loading for the front-to-back configuration (and all single table configurations) if the bridge is not already at the load station. The bridge will now move to the load area before the shuttle moves to the load area.
--[p320]-- Halts can occur by pressing the halt button, opening a door, or automatically from certain alarms. This logged data can be used to help make reprocessing decisions without measuring the wafer.
The polish abort log is also saved on disk similar to the alarm log data. When the log is filled with 16 polish abort events, the next event will cause the oldest event to be lost.
The following polish abort data are logged:
--[p319]-- Bridge Move before F-B Rinse:
Version 4.28 ensures that the bridge is moved over the load stations when using "Start with Unload" before the front-to-back throughput mechanism rinses turn on. This makes sure the rinse stations are properly covered by carriers.
Version 4.28 adds logging of polish abort data for up to 16 polish abort events. A polish abort occurs anytime the 6DS-SP is halted or aborted during polishing.
--[p320]-- New function key choices "Show Alarms" and "Show Aborts" permit viewing either the alarm log or the polish abort log.
Polish abort logged data will appear as shown in the following examples:
"LT wfr" and "RT wfr" refer to the wafers' locations on the left and right spindles.
For 6DS-SP's with two send cassettes, cassette "1" is the left rear send cassette and cassette "2" is the right rear send cassette. For 6DS-SP's with only one send cassette, it will be "1".

===== [p430-430] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Computer Setup (for technicians): (2块) =====
--[p430]-- Computer Setup (for technicians):
If the 6DS-SP computer is an IBM Model 7585 the computer’s parallel port must be configured as PC/AT Compatible. Use the following steps:
1) Cycle the 6DS-SP power off and then on.
2) During the computer’s memory test, when a rectangular icon is displayed in the upper right corner of the display, press the F1 key. This will call the Configuration Utility.
3) Use the Page Up and Page Down keys to display Page 3 of the computer’s configuration setup.
--[p430]-- 4) Use the Up and Down keys to select the Parallel Port mode.
5) Us the Left and Right Arrow keys to set the Parallel Port mode for “PC/AT Compatible”.
6) Press the Esc key to exit the configuration setup program. Follow the screen prompts to save your changes and continue the boot up process.

===== [p428-428] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Optional Carrier Unloading Sequence for Two Table Machines: (4块) =====
--[p428]-- Carriers are placed on the fixtures and then slid onto the load stations. After removing the fixtures, the "Load Carrs" choice in the Auto Polish menu is used to load the carriers onto the spindles.
--[p428]-- Optional Carrier Unloading Sequence for Two Table Machines:
Calibration Variable 161 "Unld carrs to TBL2(0-no, 1-yes)" permits an optional carrier unloading sequence when the "Unld Carrs" choice is selected in the Auto Polish menu. This optional sequence causes carriers to be unloaded onto the second table surface instead of onto the load stations. The operator can then slide carriers on the table surface to the front of the machine.
--[p428]-- Carriers that are near the front of the machine instead of on the load stations can be more easily lifted and removed from the machine.
Set Calibration Variable 161 "Unld carrs to TBL2(0-no, 1-yes)" to "1" to use the optional sequence and unload carriers onto the second table surface.
Set Calibration Variable 161 to "0" to unload carriers onto the load stations.
NOTES: Calibration Variable 38 "Spindles down soft value" is used to lower spindles during carrier unloading.
--[p428]-- This force should be enough to fully lower carriers onto the second table. If the force is too small, the spindles may not fully lower and carriers may drop a small distance to the second table.
Calibration Variable 161 is applicable only to two table machines and is ignored if Calibration Variable 160 "2nd table (0-no. 1-yes)" is set to "0" specifying a single table machine.
For carrier loading, fixtures are available for easier lifting of carriers into the machine.

===== [p389-389] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.20 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Send Cassette Retry Disable Feature: (3块) =====
--[p389]-- If set to "0" (partially filled send cassettes permitted), if a send cassette slot is sensed empty, the next slot will be searched because an empty slot is permitted.
If set to "1" (only full send cassettes permitted), if a send cassette slot is sensed empty, the next slot will not be searched and the alarm "WAFER NOT FOUND IN SEND CASS. (abort clears)" will show.
--[p389]-- After the robot arm returns to the zero position, the cycle will stall making it easy to see the physical status of the cassette slot.
NOTE: This feature applies only to send cassettes being used for polishing. It does not apply when using cassettes for the Scrubber or Nova transfer modes.
--[p389]-- Send Cassette Retry Disable Feature:
Version 4.20 adds a choice that will cause an automatic cycle to stall if a send cassette is expected to be full but a slot is detected empty. This feature prevents the cycle from continuing to search the next slot when a wafer is actually in the previous slot but was not detected for some reason.
Calibration Variable 40 "Send cass. (0-partial, 1-full)" determines whether or not the feature is used.

===== [p221-221] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Choice to Limit Primary Table Oscillation Stroke: (2块) =====
--[p221]-- Choice to Limit Primary Table Oscillation Stroke:
Version 4.35 adds a choice to limit the primary table oscillation stroke to a maximum of either 6 inches or 1 inch. Originally it was fixed at 6 inches maximum.
Calibration variable 236 "TBL1 stroke limit(0:6in,1:1in)" sets this limit.
The 6 inch choice permits the maximum practical oscillation when over the primary table.
--[p221]-- The 1 inch choice permits limiting the oscillation stroke for applications where options may mechanically interfere with carriers if using larger strokes.
The Machine Parameter menu, page 1, will show the limit selected by calibration variable 236 as either "Osc. Stroke (TBL1 6 max.)" or "Osc. Stroke (TBL1 1 max.)"

===== [p368-368] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.23.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Automated Process Control/Monitor: (2块) =====
--[p368]-- Automated Process Control/Monitor:
Version 4.23 adds support for Automated Process Control (APC) and Automated Process Monitoring (APM). These features apply to primary table polishing only. An external controller provides the control and monitoring functions as well as a separate user interface. This controller, using the GEM interface, communicates with the 6DS-SP. (Refer to the controller's documentation for further details of its operation.)
--[p368]-- The 6DS-SP Machine Parameters menu will show an Auto Process Control Step parameter. The range is 0 through 10. If set to "0", automated process control is disabled. If set in the range of "1" through "10", that primary table step can be changed by the external controller.

===== [p187-188] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Independent Left/Right Throughput Up/Dn Robot Bottom Positions (also affects AGV configuration): (7块) =====
--[p188]-- If the machine is the AGV configuration and calibration variables 246-247 are found to be zero, the software will automatically load them from the old variables and a red notification screen will show.
If the machine is neither an AGV nor high throughput configuration, none of these variables apply.
The automatic transfer of values from old variables to uninitialized new variables ensures the machine will behave exactly as it did before upgrading software.
--[p187]-- Alarm 209 "ROBOT UP/DN NOT ARRIVING AT TPUT/AGV TOP" Alarm 210 is "ROBOT UP/DN NOT ARRIVING AT TPUT/AGV BOT"

--[p187 [表]]-- The following table shows the previous two multiple use calibration variables (88-89) and the five new independent variables (243-247) that replace them.
Previous variable (obsolete) For high throughput configuration For AGV configuration
88&quot;Thruput unload/AGV up/dn top&quot; | 243 &quot;Robot up/dn tput top position&quot; | 246 &quot;Robot up/dn AGV top position&quot;
--[p187]-- Since original calibration variables were also shared with the AGV configuration, new variables have also been assigned for the AGV station up/dn top and bottom positions although there is no functional change to machine operation. As a result, AGV and throughput configurations no longer share robot up/dn calibration variables.
Manual Control menu "Robot Up/Down Move" choices will now include "L Tput Bot" and "R Tput Bot" for throughput configurations.
--[p188]-- SPECIAL NOTE: If you upgrade from a previous version, the older variables 88 and 89 are no longer used. However, they will still remain in the Calibration/Configuration disk file CALVARS.DAT. If you load a version older than 4.37, that older version will use the older variables and not the new ones. This can change the behavior of the machine because variable 89 will once again be used for both left and right throughput up/dn bottom positions.
Also, the older variables won't reflect any subsequent calibration changes in the new variables for both high throughput and AGV configurations.
--[p187]-- Independent Left/Right Throughput Up/Dn Robot Bottom Positions (also affects AGV configuration):
Version 4.37 adds separate left and right up/dn robot bottom positions for the throughput unload station for either the "side-to-side" or "front-to-back" high throughput configurations.

===== [p389-389] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.20 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > "Front to Back" High Throughput Mechanism Support: (3块) =====
--[p389]-- Also, the "front to back" configuration does not have the cleaning stations used with other single table configurations. Instead, the load stations are used as cleaning stations with Cleaning/Conditioning Parameter menu choices for post polish wafer and carrier cleaning. (These are the same cleaning choices that are available for two table machines.)
--[p389]-- As in the "side to side" high throughput configuration, the "front to back" configuration has a Machine Setup menu choice to enable or disable using the throughput feature. If disabled, the throughput mechanism will remain out of the way in its front position (nearest the operator door) and will not be used during auto cycling. However, the mechanism will be used for loading and unloading carriers.
--[p389]-- "Front to Back" High Throughput Mechanism Support:
Version 4.20 adds support for the "front to back" high throughput mechanism. (The original high throughput mechanism is called "side to side" because it moves sideways into the elevator area.) The "front to back" mechanism is available only on single table machines.
Calibration Variable 136 "F/B HTP present (0-no,1-yes)" must be set to "1" if this feature is installed. Otherwise variable 136 must be set to "0".

===== [p222-222] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Block Upload Count Shown When Uploading GEM Software: (1块) =====
--[p222]-- Block Upload Count Shown When Uploading GEM Software:
Version 4.35 adds the activity indication of block count when new software is being automatically uploaded from the Machine PC to the GEM PC. (These are blocks of software being uploaded to the GEM computer – not SECS message blocks.)
The block count will be appended to the text message "file uploading" in the GEM menu, page 1. If this block count freezes, then it can be known that the upload was not successful and is not continuing.

===== [p318-318] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.28 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Primary Conditioner Process Alarms: (1块) =====
--[p318]-- Primary Conditioner Process Alarms:
Version 4.28 adds primary conditioner process alarms. These alarms monitor the condition force (if the arm has controllable force) and conditioner device rotation speed (if the arm has powered rotation).
The conditioner alarm limits are set in the Alarm Parameters menu. A "zero" entry will disable alarm testing for that entry.
Primary conditioner alarms are monitored when sweeping on the table starts after a 10 second delay.
When sweeping ends, so does the alarm monitoring. If sweeping then starts again, there will be a new 10 second delay.

===== [p249-249] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.33 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Enhanced Lot/Recipe Integrity for Front-to-Back Throughput Configuration: (2块) =====
--[p249]-- If a lot has an odd number, an "odd wafer polish" will occur to finish that lot before starting the next one with a different recipe. Also a lot is defined as a single cassette for this feature.
--[p249]-- Enhanced Lot/Recipe Integrity for Front-to-Back Throughput Configuration:
Version 4.33 adds a lot/recipe integrity feature. This feature is only applicable if the machine has the front-to-back throughput configuration and is using GEM. This feature permits processing each lot with a different recipe. Lot/recipe integrity is maintained even if lots have an odd number of wafers.

===== [p379-379] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.22 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Wafer Lift Off Vacuum Alarm: (2块) =====
--[p379]-- Wafer Lift Off Vacuum Alarm:
Version 4.22 adds the alarm "WAFER LIFT OFF VACUUM LOW (abort clears).
This alarm will show if the wafer lift off vacuum does not build within 15 seconds. This is the vacuum that is applied to the wafer backside prior to raising spindles from tables. (The vacuum must exceed Calibration Variable 171 "Min lift off vacuum (psia)")
If the vacuum subesequently builds when the alarm is on, the alarm will automatically clear and the cycle will continue.
--[p379]-- However, the alarm will have been logged. An abort will also clear the alarm.
Transfer Cycle Disable of "All Wafers" and "No. of Wafers" Choices:
Version 4.22 adds a disable of the Auto Polish and Polish Parameter menu function key choices for "All Wafers" and "No. of Wafers". This disable occurs if the Machine Parameters menu "Auto Cycle" choice is set to either "ScrubXfr" or "NovaXfr".
These cycles transfer all wafers in a cassette and this change eliminates the impression that the number can be selected.

===== [p365-365] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.23.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Carrier loading: (2块) =====
--[p365]-- Carrier loading:
1) Press the "Load Carrs" choice. The carrier loading sequence will start and the "Load Carrs" choice will become disabled. The sequence will proceed until the spindles are down with vacuum pulling the carriers tight to compress the o-rings.
The prompt line will show "Latch carriers, close doors, press 'Load Carrs' to finish." and the "Load Carrs" choice will again become enabled. (The screen saver will not start so long as this message shows.)
--[p365]-- 2) Open the left polish door, latch the carriers, and close the polish door.
3) Press "Load Carrs" again and the carrier loading sequence will finish.

===== [p260-260] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.32 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Wafer Check Added for Demand Wafer Unload: (2块) =====

===== [p276-276] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.31 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > How Forces Build during a Carrier X Polishing Cycle: (3块) =====
--[p276]-- Notice in the example below how ring force is always substantial even though it is theoretically ramped from zero based on recipe settings.
--[p276]-- How Forces Build during a Carrier X Polishing Cycle:
The actual membrane pressure starts increasing from vacuum, through atmospheric pressure, and then to a positive value. The actual spindle force will start at the "pressure minimum" calibration level and not increase further until the closed loop control command exceeds that "pressure minimum". Also, both pressures can involve recipe ramp times.
--[p276]-- The effective ring force, which is a result of the other two controlled forces, can behave in ways that are not obvious. For example, since membrane force starts from vacuum but spindle force starts at the much higher pressure minimum, there will likely be some ring pressure overshoot as the polish cycle begins. This may actually help prevent wafer slipouts at the start of polishing by having the retaining ring firmly against the polishing pad as polish pressure builds.

===== [p425-425] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Change to Halt Sequence During Polishing: (1块) =====
--[p425]-- Change to Halt Sequence During Polishing:
If a halt occurs when the machine is polishing the following sequence is now used:
1) The polish sequence ends
2) Force is set to the "force minimum" values from the Calibration variables and backpressure is set to maximum vacuum.
3) After a 5 second delay to allow vacuum to build, the spindles are raised.
(Previously, polish force would be maintained until the spindles were raised.)

===== [p354-356] NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Light Tower Configuration #5 Change: (7块) =====
--[p356]-- In most systems, there will be no noticeable change because the test will immediately pass after the three second delay. For those systems that require a little more stabilization time, the extra time prevents false alarms.
--[p356]-- Version 4.24 adds a change to the timing for the "wafer found on spindle" test performed at the beginning of an automatic cycle.
Previously, the wafer test was made after a three second vacuum stabilization delay. Now up to seven additional seconds are allowed before the final decision that a wafer has been found. This permits a full ten seconds of vacuum stabilization before alarming.
--[p355]-- This configuration supports only the machine configuration that has a front-to-back throughput option with a scrubber.
Also, calibration variable 41 "Lot Integrity (0-dsbl, 1-enbl)" must be set to "1" for the yellow light operation to work properly.
The blue light now means "a send port is empty". Previously, it meant "send cassette ready to be removed". This light will now turn off only if both send cassettes are physically present.
--[p354]-- Light Tower Configuration #5 Change:
Version 4.24 changes the operation for light tower configuration #5 (set by calibration variable 98).
The flashing yellow light now means a receive cassette is ready to be removed. Previously, it meant any cassette was ready to be removed. There is no longer a light tower indication when a send cassette is ready to be removed. The intended application is to replace the receive cassette and its corresponding send cassette upon a flashing yellow light.
--[p355 [表]]-- The complete light operation for configuration #6 is now:

Red | halted) (never) | Alarm | No alarm
Yellow | (never) | A send or receive cassette (or both) ready to | No cassettes need removal
Blue | At least one send cassette port is empty | (never) | All send cassette ports filled
Wafer Found on Spindle Test Change:
--[p355]-- The flashing yellow light now means "a cassette is ready to be removed". Previously, it meant "a receive cassette is ready to be removed. This light will now be on if either a send cassette or receive cassette is ready to be removed. The operator must determine whether to remove a send cassette, receive cassette, or both depending on the the state of wafers in the machine. Also, if the light is referring to a receive cassette the lot will have also ended.

===== [p379-379] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.22 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Increased Scrubber Wafer Set Error Time: (1块) =====
--[p379]-- Increased Scrubber Wafer Set Error Time:
The 6DS-SP timer used while waiting for an acknowledge ("Ready" off) after "Wafer Set" is turned on has been increased from 5 to 10 seconds. This accomodates scrubbers with long internal tracks where 5 seconds was too short. 10 seconds will accomodate all scrubbers.

===== [p332-332] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.27 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Wafer Slipout Detection Change: (2块) =====
--[p332]-- Previously, detection could start when the spindles left the up switches. With the spindles not yet down, spindle mounted slipout sensors would give false alarms.
--[p332]-- Wafer Slipout Detection Change:
Version 4.27 changes the time when wafer slipout monitoring starts in an automatic cycle.   
This change supports new spindle mounted sensors as well as earlier bridge mounted sensors.
Wafer slipout detection will now start 0.5 seconds after the spindle(s) reaches the down switch(s). This insures that spindle mounted sensors are fully lowered before being monitored for a slipout. (Reference for technicians: The 0.5 second time is set in Flopro timer #47.)

===== [p443-444] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Throughput option Up/Down calibration (for technicians): (3块) =====
--[p444]-- NOTE: The distance from the spindle “up” positions to the throughput unload stations is much smaller than to the load stations or tables. It may be necessary to readjust the spindle “up” switches to make sure they reliably turn off when the spindles lower.
--[p443]-- Throughput option Up/Down calibration (for technicians):
Calibration Variable 49 “Spindles down thruput value”
This value should be set to apply approximately 20 lbs of down force to the throughput station.
This value sets the robot rotate position to align with the right throughput station.
Calibration Variable 88 “Thruput unload up/dn top”
This position must permit the robot end effector to clear the throughput station.
Calibration Variable 89 “Thruput unload up/dn bottom”
--[p444]-- This position must permit the robot end effector to contact a wafer resting in the throughput station.
NOTE: On two table machines calibration variables 88 and 89 can be higher than the typical Z-axis home position. In this case the Z-axis home switch must be moved to a higher location. This movement will require the recalibration of all Z-axis calibration positions.

===== [p205-205] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Faster Arm Parking after Primary Table In-Situ Conditioning: (2块) =====
--[p205]-- Faster Arm Parking after Primary Table In-Situ Conditioning:
Version 4.36 has a change to make a lever-type primary conditioning arm reach the rinse tank sooner after polishing ends. Previously, a "raise arm" sequence (used only for lever-type arms and not the lift-type arms) was started to verify that the arm had reached the "up" position. Now, the parking sequence first verifies that the arm is reliably up before immediately moving it to the rinse tank.
--[p205]-- This saves time by not starting the "raise arm" sequence unnecessarily.
This will have the greatest benefit for machines with lever-type conditioning arms where a sequence uses a ramp time to raise the arm even if the arm is already up. This change does not apply to lift-type arms because they don't use the arm raising sequence.

===== [p436-437] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Wafer handling when using Nova: (6块) =====
--[p437]-- (Nova/Buffer now clear for next wafers)
Measure neither wafer: Left unloaded to receive. Right unloaded to receive. Next wafers loaded and started polishing. (Nova/Buffer now clear for next wafers)
6DS-SP Operation when using Nova in the “Learn mode”:
A wafer with a pattern to be “learned” by the Nova measurement system can be directed to the Nova system by either of the following methods:
--[p436]-- Wafer handling when using Nova:
When using the Nova system, wafers will be loaded from the left send cassette, polished, and then placed either in the Nova system, the buffer cassette, or the receive cassette depending on whether the wafer is to be measured and whether the Nova system already has a wafer.
Whether a wafer is to be measured is determined by the setup on the Nova front end computer.
--[p436]-- The 6DS-SP and Nova system have handshake signals so that the 6DS-SP can request permission from the Nova system to place a wafer and the Nova system can reply whether the wafer is to be measured or skipped (not measured).
Wafers can be polished two at a time but the Nova system measures only one wafer at a time.
--[p437]-- (Nova/Buffer now clear for next wafers.)
Measure left wafer only: Left unloaded to Nova. Measuring starts. Right unloaded to buffer. Next wafers loaded and started polishing. Left moved from Nova to Receive when done. Right moved from buffer to Receive. (Nova/Buffer now clear for next wafers.)
Measure right wafer only: Left unloaded to receive. Right unloaded to Nova. Measuring starts. Next wafers loaded and started polishing. Right moved from Nova to Receive when done.
--[p436]-- In order to permit the 6DS-SP to continue to polish the next pair of wafers, a buffer cassette holds the second polished wafer if the Nova system is busy measuring the first polished wafer. Once the first polished wafer is measured and placed in the receive cassette, the wafer from the buffer cassette is either measured or directly placed in the receive cassette depending if it is to be measured or skipped.
--[p436]-- Only when both the Nova system and buffer cassette are clear can the next polished wafers be unloaded from the load stations.
The following are the four possible scenarios when polishing two wafers at a time:
Measure both wafers: Left unloaded to Nova. Measuring starts. Right unloaded to buffer. Next wafers loaded and started polishing. Left moved from Nova to Receive when done. Right moved from buffer to Nova. Measuring starts. Right moved from Nova to Receive when done.

===== [p431-431] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Scrubber Error Choice: (2块) =====
--[p431]-- If set to “1” the current wafers will be delivered to the receive cassette and a “finish cycle” status will automatically be set so the cycle will then end. If the scrubber error is cleared and the 6DS-SP re-started, wafers will again be delivered to the scrubber.
--[p431]-- Scrubber Error Choice:
Calibration Variable 187 “Scrb Err (0-rcv cass, 1-fin cyc)” defines what action will occur if a scrubber error occurs.
If set to “0” the current wafers and all subsequent wafers in the lot will be delivered to the receive cassette. The receive cassette will be used for the remainder of the lot even if the scrubber error clears.

--[p170]-- If the Host attempts to start wet idle or park the conditioner when the polish section is disabled, the choice will be denied.

Collection events have been added to report when the polish section becomes disabled (collection event 73) and re-enabled (collection event 74) based on monitoring Input 78 “Pol sect dsbld”.
GEM cannot perform this hardware reset. An operator must use the reset button.
If the Host attempts to “start” when the polish section is disabled, the start will be denied.

===== [p168-168] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Bridge and Robot Movement: (1块) =====
--[p168]-- Bridge and Robot Movement:
All machines: If a polish door is opened during an automatic cycle (polishing, carrier loading, carrier unloading, the demand wafer unload cycle, or the first part of the wet idle sequence) a pending bridge or robot servo move will no longer continue when the door is re-closed as in previous versions. Instead, the pending bridge or robot move will continue when the “start” button is pressed to remove the halt.
CE equipped machines: If CE hardware is installed, the “reset” button must be pressed before the start button.

===== [p340-340] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.26.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Alarms: (2块) =====
--[p340]-- If the AGV subsequently turns on "wafer set", the alarm will automatically clear and the transfer cycle will continue.
"AGV RECIPE NOT FOUND (abort clears)"
This alarm means an AGV requested recipe was not found among the recipes stored in the 6DS-SP. Recipe names must be in the range of "0" to "255". The only recovery from this alarm is an abort.
--[p340]-- Alarms:
There are three AGV related alarms.
"NO AGV 'TRANSFER REQUEST' (abort clears)"
This alarm means the AGV did not turn on "transfer request" in time after the 6DS-SP started to expect it. This time is 2 minutes. If the AGV subsequently turns on "transfer request", the alarm will automatically clear and the transfer cycle will continue.
"NO AGV 'WAFER SET' (abort clears)"
This alarm means the AGV did not turn on "wafer set" in time after the 6DS-SP "ready" went on. This time is 30 seconds.

===== [p441-441] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Nova Station Robot Up/Down calibration (for technicians): (2块) =====
--[p441]-- Nova Station Robot Up/Down calibration (for technicians):
There are three robot up/down calibration variables used at the Nova station. They should be calibrated as follows:
Calibration Variable 182 “Robot Up/Dn Nova Position”:
This position must permit the robot end effector to contact the wafer when the wafer is fully resting in the Nova wafer support arms.
Calibration Variable 188 “Robot Up/Dn Above Nova Pos’n”:
--[p441]-- This position must permit a wafer on the robot end effector to clear both the Nova wafer support arms and the Nova wafer chuck.
Calibration Variable 189 “Robot Up/Dn Mid Nova Position”:
This position must permit a wafer to be placed slightly above the lip of the Nova wafer support arms such that the arms can be closed onto the wafer while still being held on the robot end effector.

===== [p391-391] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.20 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Automatic DI/Slurry Shutoff Feature: (1块) =====
--[p391]-- Automatic DI/Slurry Shutoff Feature:
Version 4.20 adds a feature that will turn off the slurry valves, stop slurry pumps, and turn off the optional master DI water valve if a leak occurs.
Calibration Variable 54 "Slry/DI off w/leak(0-no,1-yes)" enables the feature.
If set to "0", a leak will cause an alarm only.
If set to "1", any leak will both cause an alarm and automatically cause all slurry shutoff valves to close, all slurry pumps to stop, and the optional master DI water valve to close.
However, this automatic shutoff will not occur during idling unless Calibration Variable 191 "Abort idle if leak(0-no, 1-yes)" is also set to "1".

===== [p231-231] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > "Once Only" Ex-situ Condition Feature: (3块) =====
--[p231]-- "Once Only" Ex-situ Condition Feature:
Version 4.34 adds feature to cause the 6DS-SP to perform a single ex-situ conditioning sequence at the start of an automatic cycle. After that, there will not be any more ex-situ conditioning so long as the automatic cycle continues regardless of how many lots are processed. This can be used to automatically break in a pad after the machine has been idle before starting a process that otherwise uses only in-situ conditioning.
--[p231]-- (Note: The other way to break in a pad is to have a dedicated pad break in recipe, select it, and use the "Demand Cond" choice on the Auto Polish Cycle menu. After that, select the recipe for processing wafers and start an automatic cycle.)
The "Cond#1 Ex-Situ Pre/Post/Once" will have the choices "Pre cond", "Post cond", and the new choice "Once only".
--[p231]-- The "Once only" choice causes a conditioning sequence to start at the beginning of an automatic cycle whether "Interval" is set to zero or any value. The "Interval" value is ignored. Therefore, setting the interval to zero will disable pre-conditioning and post conditioning choices, but will not disable the "once only" choice. To help indicate this, the note for "Cond#1 Ex-situ Interval" now shows "0:No Pre/Post" instead of the previous "(0:Dsbl Auto)".
To completely disable ex-situ conditioning, you must select "Pre" or "Post" and set the interval to zero.

===== [p317-317] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.28 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Process Alarm Disabling: (2块) =====
--[p317]-- NOTE: The alarm will also be disabled for a very small entered value that displays as zero. For example, if "0.02" is entered as an alarm limit, it will display as "0.0" and the alarm will be disabled. If "0.06" is entered, it will display as 0.1 and the alarm will be enabled. (There is no reason to enter such small values with more than the displayed resolution, but it is possible.)
--[p317]-- Process Alarm Disabling:
Version 4.28 permits process alarm disabling by entering a zero for its Alarm Parameters menu entry. For example, if "0" is entered for left spindle speed low alarm, that alarm will not be checked and will not occur.
This disabling also insures that existing recipes created before the addition of backpressure and primary conditioning alarms will not cause false alarms. (Existing recipes will contain "0" for these recipe elements.)

===== [p354-354] NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Pre-polish Robot Move: (2块) =====
--[p354]-- NOTE: This robot move may not be advantageous if using a high throughput option or Nova system. This is because the robot may move to other stations during polishing to service high throughput or Nova needs.
--[p354]-- Pre-polish Robot Move:
Version 4.24 adds an optional pre-polish robot move. This move places the robot as far away as possible from table slurries and sprays.
Calibration variable 91 "Pre-polish robot move(0-n,1-y)" enables this robot move.
If enabled, the robot will move to the Axis 5 position (a position nearest the elevator access doors) immediately after the last wafer is placed on the load station.
If disabled, the robot will not make this move.

===== [p390-390] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.20 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Wafer Slip-Out Sensor Feature: (2块) =====
--[p390]-- Wafer Slip-Out Sensor Feature:
Version 4.20 supports the optional wafer slip-out sensors connected to input 70 "Wafer slip-out". These sensors detect if a wafer has slipped off a carrier during polishing.
Calibration Variable 52 "Wfr slipout detect(0-no,1-yes)" enables the feature.
If set to "0", the feature is disabled. The variable must be set to "0" if the sensors are not installed.
--[p390]-- If the sensors are installed, the feature can be disabled if it is not suited to the application or is otherwise not working reliably.
If set to "1", the feature is enabled. If a slip-out sensor senses a wafer during polishing, the cycle will automatically halt in an attempt to prevent wafer breakage. The alarm message "WAFER SLIPPED OFF CARRIER (abort clears)" will show.

===== [p204-204] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Support for Single Table Configuration with HydroLift: (2块) =====
--[p204]-- Support for Single Table Configuration with HydroLift:
Version 4.36 adds support for a single table 6DS-SP configuration with dedicated cleaning stations and a HydroLift load station. With HydroLift load stations, the original dedicated cleaning stations are no longer used for post polish wafer and carrier cleaning sequences. Instead, the load station is used. The cleaning stations will still be used for loading and unloading carriers.
--[p204]-- The Conditioning/Cleaning menu, page 2, will now show the choices for using load stations as cleaning stations instead of choices for dedicated cleaning stations.

===== [p333-333] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.27 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > HydroLift Wafer Unloading Change: (3块) =====
--[p333]-- Cycle continues
For example, if the combined spindle flush water and air time is 20 seconds and the blowoff time is 10 seconds, the spindle flushing will continue for 7 seconds after the spindles start raising.
--[p333]-- HydroLift Wafer Unloading Change:
Version 4.27 changes how wafers are blown off carriers when using the HydroLift load station. During wafer unloading, the spindle flush is now used for blowoff and is allowed to continue while the spindles are raised. This continuous blowing off while the spindles are raising helps make sure the wafers don't stick to the carriers.
--[p333]-- The combined spindle flush and water and spindle flush air times (calibration variables 176 and 177) must be longer than the blowoff time (calibration variable 169) plus three seconds.
This is the sequence if combined spindle flush times are greater than blowoff time plus three seconds:
Spindle flush starts
Blowoff time starts
Blowoff time ends
3 second delay starts
3 second delay ends
Spindles start raising (with spindle flush continuing to blow wafers off carriers)
Spindle flush ends

===== [p259-259] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.32 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Throughput Improvement when Using Scrubber: (2块) =====
--[p259]-- This saves over 13 seconds/batch with a 3 byte data transfer (used by most machines) and over 17 seconds/batch with a 4 byte transfer (AGV configuration).
Note: This does not effect machines with scrubbers that do not use data transfer.
--[p259]-- Throughput Improvement when Using Scrubber:
Version 4.32 provides a throughput improvement when using a scrubber.
Previously, wafer handling waited until the wafer in the scrubber flipper had been pushed into the scrubber and the data transfer finished.
Now, wafer handling proceeds as soon as the scrubber flipper flips the wafer (the point where the wafer is committed to the scrubber).

===== [p344-344] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.26.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Description of Cassette > Scrubber Mode: (1块) =====
--[p344]-- Description of Cassette > Scrubber Mode:
This mode operates the same as the existing 6DS-SP software.

===== [p281-281] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.31 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Throughput Improvement, Choice to Not Park Ex-Situ Conditioner Between Batches: (2块) =====
--[p281]-- Throughput Improvement, Choice to Not Park Ex-Situ Conditioner Between Batches:
Version 4.31 adds a throughput improvement choice that will leave the primary table conditioner arm at the outer position instead of parking it between batches. This is only for servo type conditioner arms (calibration variable 124 set to 1, 2, or 3.). Also, this feature applies only if in-situ conditioning is not used.
--[p281]-- If in-situ conditioning is used, the arm is already left at the outer position after ex-situ conditioning in preparation for in-situ conditioning.
Calibration Variable 210 "Don't park after batch:0-n,1-y" sets this choice. If set to "0", the arm will park after each ex-situ conditioning cycle. If set to "1", the arm will be left raised at the outer position, (moved there if necessary) after conditioning. If the auto cycle finishes, the arm will then be parked before the cycle returns to idle.

--[p173]-- To change a SECS parameter:
The Communications State must be “Disabled” to change the SECS parameters.
If an attempt is made to change one of the SECS parameters with the Communication State showing “Communicating” or “Enabled”, the warning “The Communications State must be Disabled! Press ESC” will show.
If not already disabled, use the “Dsbl SECS” function key choice on the GEM menu. This should set the Communications State to “Disabled”.
(If this does not work, first press the “Enbl SECS” choice, and then press the “Dsbl SECS” choice.)

===== [p366-366] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.23.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > In situ Conditioning Cycles Choices: (2块) =====
--[p366]-- A non-zero entry will set the number of in situ cycles. After the last cycle of primary table conditioning, the primary conditioning arm will remain at the outer position in the raised position. After the last cycle of secondary table conditioning, the secondary conditioning arm will park. If a table's polishing cycle finishes before its last conditioning cycle is complete, conditioning will terminate.
Therefore, select a number of cycles so that the last conditioning cycle will finish before polishing finishes.
--[p366]-- In situ Conditioning Cycles Choices:
Version 4.23 adds InSitu#1 Conditioning Cycles amd InSitu#2 Conditioning Cycles as choices to the Conditioning/Cleaning parameters menu's page 2. These choices permit setting a number of in-situ conditioning cycles for either conditioning arm.
An entry of "0" means "unlimited cycles". This supports backward compatibility with existing recipes. As before, conditioning will be terminated when the polish cycle finishes.

===== [p204-204] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Throughput Improvement if Using Primary Table In-Situ Conditioning: (2块) =====
--[p204]-- Throughput Improvement if Using Primary Table In-Situ Conditioning:
Version 4.36 makes a change to the sequence after primary table polishing ends when using in-situ conditioning. Previously, after the arm was moved to the in-situ outer position, the sequence to raise the spindles waited for the arm to be up. Now, the spindle raising sequence will not wait for the arm to raise. Also, the arm is now checked to make sure it reached the up position at a later place in the automatic cycle.
--[p204]-- For machines with lever-type arms, the benefit of this change will increase in proportion to the length of the ramp time to raise the conditioning arm. For machines with lift-type arms, the benefit will be small because lift-type arms raise quickly.

--[p235]-- GEM Collection Events for End of Conditioning Arm Parking:
Version 4.34 adds collection events for the end of parking either conditioning arm.

===== [p78-78] USER INTERFACE REFERENCE > Abort/Reset function key: (1块) =====
--[p78]-- Abort/Reset function key:
The Abort/Reset choice always shows as the F10 key. This can be used to abort whatever the machine is doing and return everything to its default status (sprays off, servo moves stopped, etc.)
When first pressed, a warning will show which permits escaping (canceling the abort request). If pressed again, the abort/reset occurs. This second press confirmation prevents an unwanted abort/reset if F10 is accidentally pressed.

===== [p346-346] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.26.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Correction to Actions after F-B HTP Odd Wafer Abort: (1块) =====
--[p346]-- Correction to Actions after F-B HTP Odd Wafer Abort:
Version 4.26 corrects a situation where the right spindle did not have proper polish force after an abort of an odd wafer polish cycle.
Previously, if an odd wafer cycle was aborted, the next cycle could have two wafers for wafer handling but odd wafer polishing was still involved in the polish cycle.

===== [p198-198] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > Added for Version 4.37.1: (3块) =====
--[p198]-- Made correction for F-B high throughput configurations where the machine could go into wet idle before sending the last wafers of a lot to a receive cassette or scrubber when there are no more active send cassettes. This situation would occur depending on the relationship of throughput rinse time versus wafer unload rinse times. The cycle will now end properly.
--[p198]-- Added for Version 4.37.1:
Made correction regarding the backpressure process alarms. Previously, if one spindle finished polishing before the other (using endpoint detection or unequal polish times) a nuisance backpressure alarm would show for the spindle no longer polishing. This nuisance alarm will no longer occur.
Made correction for F-B high throughput configurations where the conditioner could interfere with the bridge if all of the following are true
High throughput enabled
--[p198]-- Ex-situ conditioning enabled
Using a polish time shorter than wafer load/unload time
Curtain rinsing enabled (from Machine Parameters menu), "forced" curtain rinsing enabled (calibration variables 211 and 212), or both enabled.
Now, the ex-situ conditioning won't start until any current rins ing is finished.

===== [p161-161] USER INTERFACE REFERENCE > NOTES: (1块) =====
--[p161]-- NOTES:
Transmitted characters can sometimes appear to be "echoed" and received even if the RS-232 connection is faulty, the remote device is turned off, or is disconnected. At these times, the transmitted signal can capacitively couple to the receive line and be received.
The program does not use any hardware handshaking and is primarily intended for RS-232 cabling using only the transmit and receive lines.

===== [p424-424] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Choice to Silence Alarm Buzzer for Currently Displayed Alarm: (1块) =====
--[p424]-- Choice to Silence Alarm Buzzer for Currently Displayed Alarm:
The audible electronic alarm buzzer can be silenced from the Alarm Log Menu (formerly named the "Error Log" menu).
To silence the alarm, select the Alarm Log menu and press the Stop Buzzer choice. The alarm buzzer will remain silent for the currently displayed alarm. The alarm buzzer will again sound if a new alarm occurs or if the existing alarm clears and re-occurs.

===== [p453-453] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.15 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > "WAFER FOUND ON ROBOT" (1块) =====
--[p453]-- "WAFER FOUND ON ROBOT"
This error could occur during wafer presence testing due to a short vacuum buildup "spike" due to water normally in the robot end effecter line. If this "spike" was large enough, it was falsely interpreted as a wafer present.
Control software changes have been made so these nuisance errors should no longer occur.

===== [p155-155] USER INTERFACE REFERENCE > XportRec (Export Recipe) Utility Program: (2块) =====
--[p155]-- XportRec (Export Recipe) Utility Program:
XportRec exports a 6DS-SP recipe file from the 6DS-SP format to a CSV text file format compatible w/ Microsoft Excel. (This program is the companion to MportRec which imports 6DS-SP CSV format files to recipe files with the 6DS-SP format.)
XportRec will:
· Read a 6DS-SP binary recipe file.
· Compare each recipe element against the limits established in RECLIMIT.DAT.
· Notify the operator of any out of limit recipe element.
--[p155]-- · Prompt the operator to enter a new value if desired.
· Save the modified recipe file (if new values were entered).
· Save the recipe data, along with label and limit data, in an Excel import file (.CSV).
XportRec is 6DS-SP software version specific because recipe limit tests use data in the 6DS-SP software file RECLIMIT.DAT. The initial XportRec release is compatible with 6DS-SP software versions 4.33 and 4.34.

===== [p431-431] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > New Scrubber Up/Down Calibration Variable: (1块) =====
--[p431]-- New Scrubber Up/Down Calibration Variable:
Calibration Variable 134 “Robot up/dn above scrbr pos’n” uniquely defines the robot Zaxis position for the above scrubber position. This is the position where the robot end effector is comfortably above a wafer sitting in the scrubber flipper.
NOTE: Previous software releases used calibration variable 130 “Robot up/dn above load pos’n” for the “above scrubber” position.
An existing installation should have the value discovered in variable 130 entered into variable 134.

===== [p453-453] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.15 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Current Password Level Shown at All Times: (2块) =====
--[p453]-- Current Password Level Shown at All Times:
The current password level, 'Oper', 'Engr', or 'Maint', is now shown at the far right of the menu title bar of every menu.
'Oper', which provides the most security, is "quietly" shown using the yellow title bar background.
'Engr' and 'Maint', which provide less security, are "loudly" shown using the red warning background.
--[p453]-- This warning is meant to encourage setting the password level back to the higher security 'Oper' level when engineering or maintenance tasks are finished.

===== [p220-220] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > The following provides more details: (1块) =====
--[p220]-- The following provides more details:
If set to yes, if scrubber equipped, at the start of wet idle the robot is moved to the scrubber position and the robot arm extended. If no scrubber is installed, the arm will be moved to axis 8.
This will place the end effector over a spray nozzle that is tee'd into the left load station rinse line. During wet idle the robot end effector is therefore rinsed when the left load station is rinsed.
This should not be turned on for the AGV configuration, nor for a non scrubber configuration where a cassette is being used in axis 8.

===== [p424-424] 6DS-SP VERSION 4.16.3 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Additional Rotating Axis Error Handling: (3块) =====
--[p424]-- A servo "motor error" is also called a "following error" and occurs if a servo motor's position is excessively different than expected. Extreme friction restricting table rotation could cause a motor error.
An amplifier fault indicates trouble within a servo amplifier. Excessive motor current could cause an amplifier fault.
Amplifier faults can be verified on the Diagnostic menu.
--[p424]-- Inputs 7, 8, and 10 are amplifier fault inputs for the left spindle, right spindle, and primary polish table respectively. For these inputs "On" means "OK" and "Off" means fault.
Motor errors can be verified on the servo status test display that shows when ALT-T is pressed.
Counter 29 “Rotate err axis”, viewable in the Diagnostics Menu, will also indicate which servo axis caused the error. The axis numbers and functions are:
Axis 1 Left spindle Axis 2 Right spindle Axis 4 Primary table Axis 13 Secondary table
--[p424]-- Additional Rotating Axis Error Handling:
The alarm message "ROTATING AXIS ERR(Start or abort clears)" will show if certain errors occur to table or spindle axes during polishing. Also, polishing will end and the machine will automatically halt.
These errors are:
Spindles: Servo "motor error" or Amplifier fault Primary polish table: Servo "motor error" or Amplifier fault Secondary polish table: Servo "motor error"

===== [p283-283] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.31 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Always Lower Both Spindles for Wafer Loading Choice: (2块) =====
--[p283]-- Note: Do not set this choice if only one carrier loaded. There is no automatic checking for carrier presence regarding this choice and spindles will be lowered even without carriers.
--[p283]-- Always Lower Both Spindles for Wafer Loading Choice:
Version 4.31 adds a choice to force the machine to always lower both spindles during wafer loading even if only the left or right only will be used for polishing. This choice is available to ensure that both load stations experience equal mechanical forces whether the polishing cycle uses both carriers or is in an "odd polish" cycle.
Calibration Variable 214 "Lower both spindles (0-n, 1-y)" sets whether or not to use this choice.

===== [p308-308] IMPORTANT ! > Leave Idle with Alt-L Feature: (2块) =====
--[p308]-- The idle screen prompt will show “press proper key sequence” instead of “press any key or start/halt button”. Remember, if this choice is used, anyone wanting to leave the wet idle must know that Alt-L is required.
To disable the feature and permit leaving idle with any key or the start or halt button, set variable 201 to “0”.
Note: This feature will not affect non-operator caused leaving of the idle such as a GEM remote start or a leak detected.
(A leak detected aborts wet idle so that the alarm can show and sound.)
--[p308]-- Leave Idle with Alt-L Feature:
Version 4.29.1 adds a feature to restrict to only the Alt-L key combination for Leaving (aborting) the idle. Without using this feature, the idle (either screen idle or wet idle) can be left by pressing any key or the start or halt button. This Alt-L feature especially helps prevent unauthorized personnel from causing the machine to leave the wet idle.
To enable the feature, set calibration variable 201 “Alt-L to leave idle (0-n, 1-y)” to “1”.

===== [p207-207] Homing Protection for Robot Travel if Robot Arm not OK: (for technicians): (2块) =====
--[p207]-- Homing Protection for Robot Travel if Robot Arm not OK: (for technicians):
Version 4.36 adds a warning if individually homing the robot travel (selecting "Robot Travel" instead of "Home All" on the Home Machine menu). Previously, the robot travel would home regardless of status of the robot. Now, if axes 10 or 11 are not homed ("Robot Arm" and "Robot Rotate" for RTZ robots or "Top Arm" and "Bottom Arm" for older robots) or if the robot arm is not at zero, the following warning will show:
--[p207]-- Robot not homed or zero.Continue?('Rbt Trvl' or ESC)
If you select "Robot Travel" a second time, you will override this warning and the robot travel will be homed regardless of the robot status. This override is needed for special maintenance such as working on robot travel with the robot arm or even the entire robot removed.

===== [p277-277] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.31 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Carrier X Wafer Unloading: (2块) =====
--[p277]-- Carrier X Wafer Unloading:
1) Lower spindle and wait for it to be lowered.
2) Enable membrane pressure and set control counter to 500 counts.
3) Wait 1 second (to let membrane pressure quickly build to 500 count level).
4) Start closed loop controlled blowoff membrane pressure (calibration variable 170).
5) Wait for the blowoff time (calibration variable 169). Membrane protrudes slightly.
6) Turn on wafer drop off spray (aids separation of wafer from membrane).
--[p277]-- 7) Wait for the wafer drop off spray time (calibration variable 208).
8) Start raising spindle. Set membrane pressure to full vacuum (so membrane will no longer protrude).
9) Wait for spindle up.
10) Turn off drop off spray (no longer needed).
Set membrane pressure to atmosphere (should not be protruding now).

===== [p262-262] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.32 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Close Dual Slurry Source Select Valves During Slurry System Flush: (1块) =====
--[p262]-- Close Dual Slurry Source Select Valves During Slurry System Flush:
Version 4.32 adds a change that monitors the slurry system flush valve control outputs and ensures corresponding slurry select valves outputs are off. Therefore, if output 29 is on, outputs 73 and 74 will be off. If output 30 is on, outputs 75 and 76 will be off. This reduces the chance of D.I. water being forced back into a slurry system if the slurry enable valves (controlled by outputs 23 and 24) do not block D.I.
water from flowing backwards into the slurry sources.

===== [p259-259] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.32 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Send Elevators Made Immediately "Inactive" When Cassette Arm Lifted: (2块) =====
--[p259]-- (Note: The 6DS-SP sequence has always required that the elevator be permitted to reset by raising with the cassette arm up and the door closed.)
A receive cassette will still remain active if its cassette arm is lifted with the door open to permit removing a wafer for test and then replacing the cassette for continued processing.
--[p259]-- Send Elevators Made Immediately "Inactive" When Cassette Arm Lifted:
Version 4.32 will now make a send elevator inactive when the cassette arm is lifted even if the elevator door is open. The automatic cycle will not use the send elevator until the elevator is again active. This ensures that if the door is opened and the cassette replaced without the usual sequence to reset the elevator (an operator error), the cycle won't continue with the new cassette as if it was still the old cassette.

===== [p220-220] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > "Double Conditioning" Eliminated if Using Pre-Conditioning with HTP: (1块) =====
--[p220]-- "Double Conditioning" Eliminated if Using Pre-Conditioning with HTP:
Version 4.35 HTP ex-situ conditioning if using pre-conditioning. After wafers finish polishing, an ex-situ conditioning cycle will now not occur if there are no new wafers to polish. This prevents the "double conditioning" that could previously occur when ex-situ conditioning occurred after the last wafers were polished before going idle and preconditioning occurred before the next wafers upon the next cycle start.

===== [p76-76] USER INTERFACE REFERENCE > Bezel Keyboard: (1块) =====
--[p76]-- Bezel Keyboard:
The F1 through F10 keys of the bezel keyboard will be directly below the F1 through F10 key labels on the screen.
The "Upper f / Lower f" key should always be set to upper. Since arrow keys share number key positions, "Up/Down" and "Left/Right" choices are provided using function keys to prevent tedious switching of the keyboard. (The keyboard arrow keys are not used and won't work.)
Also, the function keys are shared with alpha characters.
The "Alpha" key must be set to OFF unless entering letters when creating a recipe name.

===== [p378-378] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.22 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > "Cleaning Disabled" Notation for Certain Machine Configurations: (1块) =====
--[p378]-- "Cleaning Disabled" Notation for Certain Machine Configurations:
In some "high throughput" configurations, cleaning sprays are blocked by the next wafers to be polished when using the high throughput feature. Those configurations are the "side to side" throughput with the Hydro Lift load stations or any "front to back" throughput.
At these times, cleaning is disabled even if cleaning choices are selected in the Cleaning/Conditioning Parameters menu.
As a reminder, the notation "Cleaning disabled when thruput enabled" will show below these choices.

--[p368]-- Automated Process Control:
The controller sends messages to change polish time or backpressure for the selected primary table polish parameter step. This control may be fully automatic or may be the result of a "suggest" mode. ===== [p235-235] IMPORTANT GENERAL INFORMATION > XportRec and MportRec Utility Programs: (2块) =====
--[p235]-- XportRec and MportRec Utility Programs:
Version 4.34 has utility programs for converting 6DS-SP recipe files to and from Microsoft Excel compatible "CSV" files. The programs are called MportRec and XportRec and will be in the 6DS-SP "QB45" directory along with the various other utility programs.
XportRec and MportRec involve checking recipe entry limits and are therefore related to a particular 6DS-SP software release. In this case, version 4.34.

It is expected that these utility programs will be upgraded as needed and provided for future 6DS-SP software releases.
The document UTILS.DOC is included with the 6DS-SP documentation disk and explains these, and other, 6DS-SP utility programs.

===== [p278-278] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.31 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Carrier X Liftoff from Table: (2块) =====
--[p278]-- Carrier X Liftoff from Table:
1) Set membrane pressure to atmosphere (to start reducing from polish pressure). Extend piston plate (to give the membrane a solid backing). Turn on wafer sensing (will be used shortly).
2) Wait 2 seconds (to allow piston plate to extend).
3) Set membrane pressure to full vacuum (now that piston plate against membrane).
4) Test for wafer presence. Proceed if found, show error and keep checking if not found.
--[p278]-- 5) Retract piston plate (so that wafer won't be beyond retaining ring during lift off which could cause a wafer slipout).
6) Wait 2 seconds (for piston plate to retract).
7) Raise spindle.

===== [p251-251] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.33 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Miscellaneous Improvements: (1块) =====

===== [p378-378] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.22 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Second Table Edge Rinsing: (1块) =====
--[p378]-- Second Table Edge Rinsing:
Version 4.22 adds support for second table edge rinsing (Output 116 "TBL2 edge rinse").
The output will turn on (controlling a rinse valve) any time the table is rotating at least 1 rpm for more than 5 seconds. The 5 second delay prevents nuisance edge rinsing during maintenance such as pad changing or machine cleaning.

===== [p362-362] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.23.1 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > There are two control configurations: (1块) =====
--[p362]-- There are two control configurations:
Non-ViPRR: One backpressure line and one vacuum/blowoff line in spindle.
Must be used for vacuum chucked carriers.
Can be used for mechanically latched carriers with fixed retaining rings.   
Cannot be used with ViPRR.
ViPRR: One backpressure line and one vacuum/ring pressure line in spindle.
Cannot be used for vacuum chucked carriers.
Can be used for mechanically latched carriers with fixed retaining rings.   
Must be used with ViPRR.

===== [p259-259] 6DS-SP SOFTWARE VERSION 4.32 NEW FEATURES / INSTALLATION > Throughput Shuttle "both switches on" Alarm and Interlocking: (1块) =====
--[p259]-- Throughput Shuttle "both switches on" Alarm and Interlocking:
Version 4.32 adds an alarm that will show if both the "extend" and "retract" (sometimes named "front" and "rear") position switches are both on. This condition would indicate a machine problem. Also, software interlocking is added so that effected sequences in the machine control software do not advance during this fault.
The new alarm is 221 "TPUT SHUTTL FRONT/REAR SWITCHES BOTH ON".
